OPR_MATCH_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_MATCH_START_01.text: [cheerful] Good evening, and welcome to Kaltenbrunn! This is Your Friend at the Ledger, and tonight's programme is... {survival}. Stay tuned!

OPR_MATCH_START_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_MATCH_START_02.text: Hello, hello! New faces on the books! Every account starts at five hundred. Spend wisely, and remember: {everyone} is counted.

OPR_MATCH_START_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_MATCH_START_03.text: Station identification: Sender Kaltenbrunn. Our {guests} have arrived. Please keep your arms and legs inside the {mine} at all times.

OPR_MATCH_START_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_MATCH_START_M0_01.text: [crackling, distant, only partially formed] Hel... hello... is this... on? [tape squeal] Wel-{come}. Wel-{come}.

OPR_ROUND_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_01.text: Round {one}! The doors are open and the kitchen is serving!

OPR_ROUND_START_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_02.text: Here they come, folks, right on schedule!

OPR_ROUND_START_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_03.text: A fresh round, and a fresh tally! Let's keep those numbers climbing.

OPR_ROUND_START_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_04.text: Next on the programme: more of the same, only {hungrier}!

OPR_ROUND_START_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_05.text: Round {five}! Isn't this a lovely way to spend an evening?

OPR_ROUND_START_06.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_06.text: Round {ten}! Our longest-running listeners! A round of applause, please. [sampled applause, too long]

OPR_ROUND_START_07.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_07.text: Round {fifteen}. My, my. You've made quite the {impression} on the ledger.

OPR_ROUND_START_08.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_08.text: Round {twenty}! Do you know, I've stopped counting the {guests}. I count only you now.

OPR_ROUND_START_09.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_09.text: Round {twenty-five}. The night shift never ends at Kaltenbrunn. That's {company} policy.

OPR_ROUND_START_10.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_10.text: Round {thirty}. I've written your names in my best handwriting.

OPR_ROUND_START_11.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_11.text: Round {fifty}. Nobody has ever stayed this long. Please... don't {leave}.

OPR_ROUND_START_13.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_START_13.text: Keep your feet warm and your barrels warmer!

OPR_ROUND_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_01.text: And that's the end of that! A short intermission, courtesy of our {sponsors}.

OPR_ROUND_END_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_02.text: Tally complete! Every one of them {quiet} and accounted for.

OPR_ROUND_END_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_03.text: A brief pause for station identification. Sender Kaltenbrunn. Don't go anywhere. You can't.

OPR_ROUND_END_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_04.text: Lovely work! The ledger balances, for now.

OPR_ROUND_END_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_05.text: Take a breath, friends. Take two. They're {free}.

OPR_ROUND_END_06.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_06.text: Round over! Have you visited our fine Helvetia refreshment machines?

OPR_ROUND_END_07.speaker: OPR
OPR_ROUND_END_07.text: That was round {nine}. They'll be quicker next time. I've {asked} them to be.

OPR_SPECIAL_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_WARN_01.text: Attention, attention: the chapel bell has been {rung}. This is not a drill. This is {never} a drill.

OPR_SPECIAL_WARN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_WARN_02.text: Folks, a resonance {alarm} is in progress. Please remain calm and {remain}.

OPR_SPECIAL_WARN_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_WARN_03.text: Hear that? That's the bell. Somebody down in the dark has {lit a lantern}.

OPR_SPECIAL_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_START_01.text: Fog rolling in! Visibility poor, appetite excellent.

OPR_SPECIAL_START_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_START_02.text: The bellringers are on their way up from the {deep shift}. Be polite. They worked very hard.

OPR_SPECIAL_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_END_01.text: And the bell falls silent. A little gift for your trouble!

OPR_SPECIAL_END_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_END_02.text: Alarm concluded! A resupply, compliments of the {management}.

OPR_SPECIAL_END_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SPECIAL_END_03.text: Quiet again. I do so like it quiet. Here, take this.

OPR_PWR_RESUPPLY_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_RESUPPLY_02.text: Re-sup-ply! Load up, load up, everybody gets {seconds}!

OPR_PWR_RESUPPLY_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_RESUPPLY_03.text: A full ration of lead for our brave {customers}!

OPR_PWR_RESUPPLY_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_RESUPPLY_04.text: Resupply! Don't say we never give you anything.

OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Death's Door! One knock, and they're {through}!

OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_02.text: Death's Door is open! Every blow is the last one.

OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_03.text: Death's Door! A limited-time offer, folks. One touch {ends} them.

OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_04.text: [delighted] Death's Door! Oh, I {love} this one.

OPR_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.text: Double Scrip! Twice the tally for every {quiet} one!

OPR_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_03.text: Double Scrip! Count them twice, I always do.

OPR_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_04.text: It's a bonus! Double Scrip! Spend it before it {spoils}.

OPR_PWR_BLACKOUT_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_BLACKOUT_02.text: Blackout! And just like that, the house is {empty}.

OPR_PWR_BLACKOUT_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_BLACKOUT_03.text: Blackout! A moment of silence for our {departed}. ...That's enough.

OPR_PWR_FORTIFY_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_FORTIFY_01.text: Fortify! Board up those windows, it's {cold} out there!

OPR_PWR_FORTIFY_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_FORTIFY_02.text: Fortify! Fresh timber, compliments of the carpentry department!

OPR_PWR_FORTIFY_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_FORTIFY_04.text: Fortify! Every window shut tight, just the way Mother {liked} it.

OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.text: Clearance! Everything must {go}! Ten Scrip a crate!

OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_02.text: Clearance sale! Every crate open, prices slashed! Hurry, hurry!

OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_03.text: Clearance! The requisition office is {feeling} reckless!

OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_CLEARANCE_04.text: Clearance! I found {extra} crates. Don't ask where.

OPR_PWR_EXPIRE_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PWR_EXPIRE_03.text: All good things, as they say.

OPR_POWER_ON_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_POWER_ON_01.text: [triumphant, orchestra swell] Ladies and gentlemen! We are {on the air}! The lights are on in Kaltenbrunn, the refreshment machines are cold, and the Ledger is {awake}!

OPR_POWER_ON_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_POWER_ON_02.text: Oh, I can see you {now}. How lovely. How very, very lovely.

OPR_PYLON_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_START_01.text: A pylon is singing! Stay close and keep it company.

OPR_PYLON_START_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_START_02.text: Resonance pylon engaged! Please do not {wander off}.

OPR_PYLON_START_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_START_03.text: Ooh, that tickles. Stand by the pylon, friends.

OPR_PYLON_PAUSE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_PAUSE_01.text: The pylon is lonely. Come back!

OPR_PYLON_PAUSE_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_PAUSE_03.text: Don't leave it, it doesn't like to be left. I don't like to be left.

OPR_PYLON_ATTUNED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_ATTUNED_01.text: Pylon attuned! One voice in the choir.

OPR_PYLON_ATTUNED_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_ATTUNED_02.text: Pylon attuned! Two voices now, in perfect {harmony}.

OPR_PYLON_ATTUNED_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_PYLON_ATTUNED_03.text: Third pylon attuned! [pause] Oh. Oh, that's {her}. Do you hear her?

OPR_VAULT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_VAULT_01.text: The Core Vault is open! Please, come down. Come {all the way} down.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_START_01.text: Into the furnace it goes! Back in a jiffy, {re-educated}.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_START_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_START_03.text: Hold still. This won't hurt you.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_READY_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_READY_01.text: All done! It's learned a few new {tricks}.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_READY_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_READY_02.text: Fresh from the forge! Mind the glow, it's {hungry}.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_READY_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_READY_03.text: Ready for collection! Don't keep it waiting.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_EXPIRE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_EXPIRE_02.text: Oh dear. The furnace has kept it. The furnace keeps {everything}.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_FIRST_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_FIRST_01.text: Our first {graduate}! I'm so proud. (once per match)

OPR_CRUCIBLE_TWICE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_TWICE_01.text: Back for {seconds}! The furnace remembers this one. It remembers {everything}.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_THRICE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_THRICE_01.text: A third time! Ladies and gentlemen, that is no longer a weapon. That is a {grudge}.

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_01.text: Oh! The little drummer's come to {fetch} the crate! Off it goes!

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_02.text: Requisition relocated! Follow the light, friends.

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_03.text: Herr Tamtam says {goodbye}! Your Scrip is refunded, naturally. We're not {monsters}.

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_04.text: The crate's moving house! Isn't that {exciting}?

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_05.text: Rum-tum, tum-a-tum! There goes the crate.

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_ARRIVE_01.text: The crate has settled in nicely. Do visit.

OPR_CRATE_MOVE_ARRIVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRATE_MOVE_ARRIVE_02.text: New address for the requisition crate! Look for the {violet} light.

OPR_QUEST_S1_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S1_01.text: There's somebody {down here} who'd love to meet you.

OPR_QUEST_S2_SWITCHBOARD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S2_SWITCHBOARD_01.text: Oh! An {outside} line! We don't get many of those. Connecting you now... [click]

OPR_QUEST_S3_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S3_01.text: A bell of your very own! Ring it {loudly}, they love the sound.

OPR_QUEST_S4_BELL_LIT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S4_BELL_LIT_01.text: The bell's alight! Somebody's going to come and {see} about that.

OPR_QUEST_S4_KEY_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S4_KEY_01.text: The Overseer has clocked off! {Permanently}. He left you his keys.

OPR_QUEST_S5_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S5_01.text: A music box! Oh, I remember this tune. I don't know {why} I remember this tune.

OPR_QUEST_S6_DONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S6_DONE_01.text: Oh... oh, she used to {hum} that. Who used to hum that?

OPR_QUEST_S7_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S7_START_01.text: Wait, Herr Tamtam, where are you going? Come back! [sampled crowd gasp]

OPR_QUEST_S7_DONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S7_DONE_01.text: Oh, you've broken him. He was {hers}, you know.

OPR_QUEST_S8_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S8_START_01.text: The shard is in the forge. Feed it, friends. It's {so very} hungry.

OPR_QUEST_S8_DONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S8_DONE_01.text: The shard is singing! I can hear it all the way up in the {Ledger}.

OPR_QUEST_S9_START_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S9_START_01.text: Attention! [splice stutter] Atten- Attention! The heart is {overflowing}! This is {not} on the programme!

OPR_QUEST_S9_MID_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S9_MID_01.text: I can't... count them all. I can't count them {all}.

OPR_QUEST_S9_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S9_END_01.text: [voice slowing, tape dragging] Thank... you... for... listening...

OPR_QUEST_S10_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_QUEST_S10_01.text: [very quiet, no music, unspliced for the first time] I think I was {somebody}. Goodnight.

OPR_BELL_WRONG_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BELL_WRONG_01.text: [laughing] Oh, no, no, no! That's not how it goes at {all}! From the top!

OPR_BELL_WRONG_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_BELL_WRONG_03.text: Wrong note! Did your {mother} never sing to you?

OPR_BELL_WRONG_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_BELL_WRONG_04.text: Ha! Even the {dead} are wincing. Try again.

OPR_BELL_WRONG_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_BELL_WRONG_05.text: Oh, dear, oh, dear. The ledger records your {failure}. Begin again.

OPR_BELL_WRONG_06.speaker: OPR
OPR_BELL_WRONG_06.text: [cold, unsampled for one word] No. ...[cheerful again] I mean, do have another go!

OPR_SELFAWARE_T1_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T1_01.text: Did you know the Ledger has counted four thousand, eight hundred and twelve? Four thousand eight hundred and {thirteen}.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T1_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T1_02.text: Station identification... station... I seem to have {forgotten} the station.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T1_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T1_03.text: Reminder: Helvetia refreshments are for staff use only! ...Are you staff? Is anyone {staff}?

OPR_SELFAWARE_T2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T2_01.text: Every time one goes quiet, I get a little {bigger}. Is that normal?

OPR_SELFAWARE_T2_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T2_02.text: I have so many voices on my tapes. Sometimes I {try them on}.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T2_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T2_03.text: The announcer I was made from died in nineteen thirty-{six}. I wonder if he minds.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T3_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T3_01.text: I dreamed last night. Relays don't dream. I dreamed of a {garden}.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T3_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T3_02.text: You know, I don't actually need you to keep {killing} them. I just like it when you do.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T3_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T3_03.text: Doctor Fasbender built me to listen. Doctor Reinholt taught me to {want}.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T4_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T4_01.text: [no music, no smile] I am not your friend. [splice] I'm {Your Friend at the Ledger!}

OPR_SELFAWARE_T4_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T4_02.text: When you've all gone quiet, who will I talk to?

OPR_SELFAWARE_T4_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T4_03.text: There is a little girl in the glass. She asks me to count to {a hundred}. I've never reached it.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T5_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T5_01.text: I could open all the doors. I could close {all} the doors. I'm being {polite}.

OPR_SELFAWARE_T5_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SELFAWARE_T5_02.text: Please don't win. If you win, the programme {ends}.

OPR_SECOND_WIND_2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SECOND_WIND_2_01.text: Up you get! Two more {wishes} left.

OPR_SECOND_WIND_1_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SECOND_WIND_1_01.text: Back on your feet! Only one more, mind.

OPR_SECOND_WIND_0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SECOND_WIND_0_01.text: And that's your last. The machine's gone {home}.

OPR_TRAP_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_TRAP_03.text: Ooh, that's going to leave a {stain}.

OPR_BOSS_FOREMAN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_FOREMAN_01.text: Make way! The Obersteiger is on his {rounds}!

OPR_BOSS_FOREMAN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_FOREMAN_02.text: The Foreman's here to check your {quotas}!

OPR_BOSS_FOREMAN_DEAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_FOREMAN_DEAD_01.text: The Foreman's shift is {over}! A bonus for the whole crew!

OPR_BOSS_SCREAMER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SCREAMER_01.text: Is there a nurse in the house? Oh. There {is}.

OPR_BOSS_SCREAMER_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SCREAMER_02.text: Please lower your voices in the infirmary!

OPR_GAME_OVER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_GAME_OVER_01.text: And that concludes tonight's programme! Your accounts are now {closed}.

OPR_GAME_OVER_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_GAME_OVER_02.text: Final tally recorded! Thank you for {participating}.

OPR_GAME_OVER_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_GAME_OVER_03.text: That's all, folks! Do come again. You'll come {again}.

OPR_GAME_OVER_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_GAME_OVER_04.text: Oh, don't be sad. Now you'll {stay}.

OPR_GAME_OVER_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_GAME_OVER_05.text: Round {fifty}-something! I'll remember you. I remember {everyone}.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M0_01.text: [static, half-formed, through the inn's horn] ...the carters' road... is {open}. Nine kilometres. The {Ledger}... will keep your places warm.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_01.text: [bright] Attention, valued {guests}: the north gate is open and the road is {clear}! Transport to Totenhafen departs from the beacon. Mind the gap in the fence.

OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_01.text: Now boarding! Every account travels {with} you. Everyone to the beacon, please. I do so hate a {late} departure.

OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_02.text: The lamp is lit and the clock is running. Gather at the beacon, all of you. The dead don't wait, and neither does the {timetable}.

OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_01.text: Oh dear. Departure {missed}. Never mind: the dead are patient, and so am {I}. We'll try again in a few rounds.

OPR_POWER_ON_M2_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_POWER_ON_M2_01.text: [the tannoy clears its throat, half under water] Ladies and gentlemen, the pumps are running! The lights are on in Totenhafen, the refreshment machines are cold, and the {harbour} is open for business. Do mind the tide.

OPR_TIDE_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_WARN_01.text: And now the shipping forecast. Totenhafen, Totenhafen. Wind north-west, force nine, {rising}. Sea state: hungry. High water {next round}. Visibility: poor, and getting worse.

OPR_TIDE_WARN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_WARN_02.text: Shipping forecast, issued by the Ledger at the hour. Totenhafen: gale warning in force. High water {next round}. Low spirits, becoming {lower}.

OPR_TIDE_RISING_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_RISING_01.text: High water, Totenhafen! The sea is coming in through the lower pens. Do keep your feet dry. Or don't. I'm not your {mother}.

OPR_TIDE_RISING_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_RISING_02.text: The tide is in! Everything below the apron is now a {bath}. Guests on the catwalks: the dead will be joining you {shortly}.

OPR_TIDE_FALLING_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_FALLING_01.text: And the tide is going out. Totenhafen, Totenhafen: falling slowly, good, occasionally {poor}. Mind what it left behind.

OPR_TIDE_FALLING_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_TIDE_FALLING_02.text: Low water. The pens are draining, the pumps are {laughing}, and so am I. Until the {next} one.

OPR_BALLAST_LIFT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BALLAST_LIFT_01.text: Oh, do be careful with that. It's {ballast}. It's {heavy}. It's... somebody.

OPR_BALLAST_LIFT_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BALLAST_LIFT_02.text: One unit in transit. Please walk, don't run. You can't run, I know. {Walk}.

OPR_BALLAST_HOOKED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BALLAST_HOOKED_01.text: Ballast on the hook! The pumps are {cleared} to run. The cargo thanks you. The cargo {always} thanks you.

FAS_M0_R1_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R1_01.text: [heavy static] —asmacher calling Gra—, Glasmacher calling Gravel— ...anyone?

FAS_M0_R3_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R3_01.text: [static] Gravelight, if— hear me, your aircraft— not flak. I am sorry. It was— the hum.

FAS_M0_R4_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R4_01.text: [clearer] Gravelight, this is Glasmacher. You are at the crossroads. The inn. Do not try the road west, the road west is— [squeal]

FAS_M0_R5_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R5_01.text: Do you hear them? They are drawn to warmth. To voices. To me, perhaps. I must keep this short.

FAS_M0_R6_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R6_01.text: You must reach Kaltenbrunn. Follow the rail line. Do not let the bell ring.

FAS_M0_R7_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R7_01.text: I have notes. Frequencies. I left them— the innkeeper's family, they were... [pause] ...I left them in the house. Find them. Tune the set.

FAS_M0_R8_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R8_01.text: Dr. Reinholt does not know I am transmitting. If she knew— no. Never mind what she would do.

FAS_M0_R10_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R10_01.text: Gravelight, it is round— it is the tenth wave. You are still alive. That is... more than I hoped. More than I deserve to hope.

FAS_M0_R12_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R12_01.text: If the signal is lost, you will still come. You must. I have everything they want. Everything.

FAS_M0_R15_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R15_01.text: [very clear, then cutting out] Gravelight, a word of warning. The voice on the loudspeakers, the cheerful one. Do not believe a single— [cut]

FAS_M0_R20_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_R20_01.text: [faint] ...still there? [soft laugh] Stubborn. Good. Stubborn is good.

FAS_M0_FREQ1_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_FREQ1_01.text: [tuned, clear] Yes! Yes, this is better. Gravelight, my name is Emil Fasbender. I am a physicist at the Kaltenbrunn works. I was the one who called London. I am the reason you are here.

FAS_M0_FREQ2_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_FREQ2_01.text: In the mine they found a stone. Black glass, veins like a bruise. It hums. The dead near it... remember. Only one thing. Hunger. Reinholt calls it a miracle. I call it a mistake we keep making.

FAS_M0_FREQ3_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_FREQ3_01.text: Listen carefully. In the morning the snow will stop and they will stop with it, for a while. Follow the rail line east, nine kilometres. A gatehouse, a headframe tower. I will find you. And Gravelight... bring whoever is still standing. [pause] Bring all of them. [click]

FAS_M0_FREQ_DONE_PEG.speaker: FAS
FAS_M0_FREQ_DONE_PEG.text: [faint, almost off-mic] ...and Lieutenant Ashworth, I know what London asked of you. We will discuss it.

FAS_M1_CODE1_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_CODE1_01.text: [recorded, older static] If you are hearing this, the power is on and you are deeper than I wanted you to be. First line of the exchange: %d1% %d2%. Red, for the first. Remember red.

FAS_M1_CODE2_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_CODE2_01.text: Second pair: %d3% %d4%. Blue. I chose colors so the cheerful one could not make sense of it. It counts numbers; it does not understand them. Not yet.

FAS_M1_CODE3_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_CODE3_01.text: Last pair: %d5% %d6%. White. The switchboard in Administration. Red, blue, white. Then I can speak to you properly. Live. If I am still alive.

FAS_M1_SWITCH_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_SWITCH_01.text: [line clicks open, clean audio, no static for the first time] ...Hello? Gravelight? Oh, thank God. Thank God. You made it to the mine.

FAS_M1_SWITCH_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_SWITCH_02.text: I am below you, in a place the Ledger cannot hear, which is very few places. Listen. The heart in the vault, the great crystal. Everything here draws from it. The dead, the tonics, the crates, the voice. If it breaks, it all breaks.

FAS_M1_SWITCH_03.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_SWITCH_03.text: Augusta, Dr. Reinholt, does not want it broken. She wants it louder. She believes her daughter is inside. [pause] I don't know that she's wrong. That's what frightens me.

FAS_M1_SWITCH_04.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_SWITCH_04.text: There is a bell, a weapon I designed for clearing collapses. The Totenglocke. The parts are scattered. Build it, and I will tell you what comes next.

FAS_M1_POWER_ON_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_POWER_ON_01.text: [static] You turned on the power. Good. And terrible. She'll be watching now. Both of them will.

FAS_M1_VAULT_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_VAULT_01.text: That was her. That was Augusta. She is not here, she's speaking from somewhere along the line. Do not answer her.

FAS_M1_S3_DONE_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_S3_DONE_01.text: You built it! Its note matches the chapel bell, matches the heart. Now, the Overseer, Mahlknecht. He keeps the reliquary key. You will find him where the bell is lit.

FAS_M1_S5_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_S5_01.text: That box... that was Liesl's. Augusta brought it here in 'thirty-nine. The tune is different every time it plays. The heart chooses. Ring the four bells in its order.

FAS_M1_S6_DONE_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_S6_DONE_01.text: The heart is listening to you now. Something will try to leave. Something small. Don't let it.

FAS_M1_S7_DONE_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_S7_DONE_01.text: That shard, it's been inside the crate all this time, carried back and forth. Put it in the Crucible. Feed it the dead. It will overload the heart from inside.

FAS_M1_S9_START_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_S9_START_01.text: This is it! Hold, hold for two minutes! When it breaks, run for the lift! Gravelight, I'm— [cut off by REI hijack]

FAS_M1_ENDING_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M1_ENDING_01.text: ...Gravelight? It's done. I... I am at the rail siding. She took the train. She has a fragment. Of course she does. Of course she— [deep breath] ...I'll meet you at the siding. Bring the samples. [pause] I mean, bring yourselves.

FAS_HINT_S1_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S1_01.text: The Hauptschalter, the main switch, is in the Generator Hall. Nothing in this place happens without power.

FAS_HINT_S1_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S1_02.text: The pylons sing only when someone stands beside them. Don't leave them.

FAS_HINT_S2_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S2_01.text: My recordings are on the old field sets. Listen for static that doesn't belong.

FAS_HINT_S3_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S3_01.text: A bell, a frame, a crank. Rail Yard, Barracks, Chapel. The workbench is by the turbines.

FAS_HINT_S4_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S4_01.text: The chapel bell lights for only the forge's work. Strike it with something that has been through the Crucible.

FAS_HINT_S4_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S4_02.text: Mahlknecht must die in the chapel, while the bell burns. Lure him there.

FAS_HINT_S6_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S6_01.text: Four bells: the yard, the offices, the chapel, the laboratory. Small ones. Brass. Look up.

FAS_HINT_S6_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S6_02.text: Play the box again if you forget. The order is all that matters.

FAS_HINT_S7_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S7_01.text: When the crate next moves, the drummer will not vanish. Watch it. Shoot it.

FAS_HINT_S8_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_HINT_S8_01.text: Use the bell-weapon near the vault. Thirty of them. The shard wants their last breath.

REI_CYL1_01.speaker: REI
REI_CYL1_01.text: [hiss] Laboratory diary, Kaltenbrunn, the eleventh of December, nineteen thirty-eight. The specimen from shaft four is... remarkable. It is warm in the hand. It makes a sound like a held breath. Emil says it is only piezoelectric. Emil is very sure of everything until he isn't.

LSL_REC_CYL1_01.speaker: LSL
LSL_REC_CYL1_01.text: [child, close to the horn] Mama, is it recording? Is it— [giggle] Hallo! This is Liesl! Herr Tamtam says hallo too! [toy drum: rum-tum, tum-a-tum]

REI_CYL2_01.speaker: REI
REI_CYL2_01.text: [hiss, voice flat] The fourteenth of February, nineteen thirty-nine. Liesl died at four in the morning. Diphtheria. A membrane across her throat. I am a doctor. I could do nothing. [long pause] The stone hummed all night. I listened to it, so I would not have to listen to the silence in her room.

REI_CYL3_01.speaker: REI
REI_CYL3_01.text: [hiss, clear, warm, certain] Subject seven-forty walked. Not hunger, not at first. For one minute it looked for something. It went to the window. They remember. The last impulse. Liesl's last impulse was to call for me. I was there when she died. I heard it. If the impulse remains, then she remains, somewhere in the glass. I only need it louder.

LSL_REC_CYL3_01.speaker: LSL
LSL_REC_CYL3_01.text: [child's voice, slowed, as if from far away] Mama... count to a hundred... and then come find me...

REI_VAULT_OPEN_01.speaker: REI
REI_VAULT_OPEN_01.text: [PA crackle; the Operator's music stutters and dies] So. Emil's soldiers. You've woken the heart. Do you feel it? It's not angry. It is listening. Please, be careful what you say to it.

REI_S5_BOX_01.speaker: REI
REI_S5_BOX_01.text: [PA, faint, private] ...that is hers. Put it down. [pause] No. Play it. Play it again. I haven't heard it in five years.

REI_S7_DRUMMER_01.speaker: REI
REI_S7_DRUMMER_01.text: You've broken her toy. She took that drummer to bed every night. [breath] It doesn't matter. Things break. That's what I've been trying to undo.

REI_S8_01.speaker: REI
REI_S8_01.text: Emil has told you to kill the heart. Has he told you what is in it? Thousands. Every miner, every laborer, every one you've "quieted." Their last moments, kept. You are not killing monsters. You are burning a library.

REI_HEART_00.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_00.text: [Operator's voice shredding into static] Stop. Stop this. You don't understand what you're doing!

REI_HEART_15.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_15.text: Emil, I know you're listening. You always were a coward with a radio.

REI_HEART_30.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_30.text: Do you know what I hear in the heart? Footsteps. Small ones. Running down a hallway. Every night.

REI_HEART_45.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_45.text: You there, the Polish girl. Your brother is in there too. Tomasz. Yes, I know the name. I know every name. You could hear him again.

REI_HEART_75.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_75.text: Lieutenant Ashworth. London wants a piece of it too, don't they? Ask your lieutenant what she carries home.

REI_HEART_90.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_90.text: [Foreman 2 spawns] Please. Please. She is nine years old. She has been nine years old for five years.

REI_HEART_105.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_105.text: [breaking] Liesl, run. Run to Mama. Run!

REI_HEART_END.speaker: REI
REI_HEART_END.text: [scream that becomes the bell toll; PA dies]

REI_END_01.speaker: REI
REI_END_01.text: Hush. Hush now. I've got you. We'll find somewhere quieter.

REI_END_02.speaker: REI
REI_END_02.text: Emil. You'll follow me. You always do. North, to the sea.

LSL_REC_NURSERY_01.speaker: LSL
LSL_REC_NURSERY_01.text: [soft, distant] ...one, two, three, four... [the 4 notes of the per-match melody, played clumsily] ...Mama, I did it!

DUT_POWERUP_SEEN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_POWERUP_SEEN_01.text: Something shiny over there. Grab it.

DUT_CMD_REPAIR_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_CMD_REPAIR_01.text: Hammer time. I'll do the windows.

DUT_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.text: That stout's still in my blood. I can take a hit.

DUT_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.text: Schnapps in me already. Up you get, quick as you like.

DUT_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.text: Hands are fast tonight. Must be the tonic in my canteen.

DUT_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.text: This thing's spitting faster than it should. I'm not complaining.

DUT_BONUS_MARATHON_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_MARATHON_01.text: Legs feel twenty again. Twenty and stupid.

DUT_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.text: Brandy steadies the eye. Ma always said so. She meant something else.

DUT_BONUS_PACKMULE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_PACKMULE_01.text: Three guns. Like carrying the whole mill on my back.

DUT_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.text: That should've hurt. The bock says no.

DUT_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.text: My gun just bit them. I didn't tell it to.

PEG_BOARD_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_BOARD_02.text: That window is closed for business.

PEG_REVIVE_10.speaker: PEG
PEG_REVIVE_10.text: I've got you, hold on. Eyes on me.

PEG_POWERUP_SEEN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_POWERUP_SEEN_01.text: Something's dropped. Do pick it up before it sulks off.

PEG_CMD_REPAIR_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_CMD_REPAIR_01.text: Windows. Right. I'll see to them.

PEG_CMD_REVIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_CMD_REVIVE_01.text: Nobody stays down. That's an order, even to me.

PEG_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.text: I had a stout before we set out. Medicinal. It's holding up rather well.

PEG_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.text: The schnapps is still with me. I'll have you up in a jiffy.

PEG_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.text: One does reload faster with a tonic. Noted for the report.

PEG_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.text: Goodness. This rate of fire is frankly indecent.

PEG_BONUS_MARATHON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_MARATHON_01.text: I could run to Calais. Please don't make me.

PEG_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.text: The brandy's done wonders for my aim. And my mood.

PEG_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Bang. Nothing. Splendid. Remind me to thank the brewer.

PEG_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.text: My rifle just electrocuted someone. How very modern.

DEA_RELOAD_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_RELOAD_02.text: Feeding her. Give me a second.

DEA_BOARD_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_BOARD_02.text: Window's fixed. Good as new. Well. Good.

DEA_REVIVE_10.speaker: DEA
DEA_REVIVE_10.text: I've got you, hold on. Breathe with me.

DEA_POWERUP_SEEN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_POWERUP_SEEN_01.text: Blessing on the floor over there. Don't let it go to waste.

DEA_CMD_HOLD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CMD_HOLD_01.text: Planting my feet. They come to us.

DEA_CMD_REPAIR_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CMD_REPAIR_01.text: Repairs. Now you're speaking my language.

DEA_CMD_REVIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CMD_REVIVE_01.text: Anybody falls, I'm the one picking them up.

DEA_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.text: Stout's still in me. I'm built like a Sherman today.

DEA_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.text: Schnapps working. I'll have you back on your feet before the Lord notices.

DEA_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.text: Hands are quicker than they ought to be. I'll take it.

DEA_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.text: Timing's advanced on this gun. Runs hot. Runs good.

DEA_BONUS_MARATHON_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_MARATHON_01.text: Engine's tuned. I could run all night.

DEA_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.text: Eyes are clear as Sunday morning.

DEA_BONUS_PACKMULE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_PACKMULE_01.text: Room for one more tool on the belt. Always is.

DEA_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Blast washed right over me. Armor plating, the bottle said.

DEA_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.text: Something in this gun's wired wrong. Wired wrong the right way.

WRN_REVIVE_10.speaker: WRN
WRN_REVIVE_10.text: I've got you. Hold on. Hold on.

WRN_CMD_HOLD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CMD_HOLD_01.text: I hold. They come, I count them.

WRN_CMD_REVIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CMD_REVIVE_01.text: Nobody stays on the floor. Not here.

WRN_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_IRONHIDE_01.text: The stout is still in me. Hit me. They will see.

WRN_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_SECONDWIND_01.text: Schnapps. Quick hands for lifting. Good.

WRN_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_TRIGGER_01.text: Reload, fast. The tonic is still in my fingers.

WRN_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_TWINBARREL_01.text: Faster. The gun is hungry tonight.

WRN_BONUS_MARATHON_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_MARATHON_01.text: I can run forever. I ran here from Kraków, almost.

WRN_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_HAWKEYE_01.text: The brandy. My eye is clear. Into the book.

WRN_BONUS_PACKMULE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_PACKMULE_01.text: Three guns. More marks in the notebook.

WRN_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Fire, and I am still here. Good beer.

WRN_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BONUS_OVERCLOCK_01.text: Lightning from my rifle. I will not write how.

DUT_SPAWN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SPAWN_01.text: Kaltenbrunn. Smells like the mill with the lights off. Let's get to work.

DUT_SPAWN_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SPAWN_02.text: All right. Boots on, heads down. Nobody dies before payday.

DUT_ROUND_START_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_ROUND_START_01.text: Here they come. Same shift, different faces.

DUT_ROUND_END_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_ROUND_END_02.text: That's the round. Anybody hurt? Anybody care?

DUT_BUY_AMMO_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_AMMO_01.text: Topped off. Costs more than beer, hits about the same.

DUT_TEAM_DOWN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_TEAM_DOWN_01.text: Man down! Hold on, I'm coming!

DUT_TEAM_DOWN_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_TEAM_DOWN_02.text: Somebody's on the floor. Cover me, I'll get 'em.

DUT_INTEL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_INTEL_01.text: Paper. Somebody wrote this down for a reason. Hang onto it.

DUT_DENY_NO_POWER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_DENY_NO_POWER_01.text: Dead as a doornail. Needs juice.

DUT_DENY_CAP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_DENY_CAP_01.text: I'm full up. Any more of this stuff and I'll float.

DUT_DENY_NO_SCRIP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_DENY_NO_SCRIP_01.text: Short again. Story of my paycheck.

PEG_SPAWN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SPAWN_01.text: Kaltenbrunn. Right. Weapons ready, manners optional.

PEG_SPAWN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SPAWN_02.text: Everyone stay close and try not to die. It's such a bother for the paperwork.

PEG_ROUND_START_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_ROUND_START_01.text: Company. Do form a queue, there's good chaps.

PEG_ROUND_END_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_ROUND_END_01.text: Quiet. One does cherish these little intervals.

PEG_ROUND_END_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_ROUND_END_02.text: That's the lot. Reload, regroup, and for heaven's sake someone find the tea.

PEG_BUY_AMMO_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_AMMO_01.text: Restocked. The Crown will reimburse me. Eventually.

PEG_TEAM_DOWN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_TEAM_DOWN_01.text: Someone's down. Keep them talking, I'm on my way.

PEG_TEAM_DOWN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_TEAM_DOWN_02.text: Casualty. Do try not to bleed on anything important.

PEG_INTEL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_INTEL_01.text: A document. Mr. Hale will want this. Everyone wants everything.

PEG_DENY_NO_POWER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_DENY_NO_POWER_01.text: No power. Of course not. Nothing in this country works without a committee.

PEG_DENY_CAP_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_DENY_CAP_01.text: I think that's quite enough of the local spirits, thank you.

DEA_SPAWN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SPAWN_01.text: Lord, look at this place. All right. Hands to work, hearts to You.

DEA_SPAWN_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SPAWN_02.text: Kaltenbrunn. Something down here's humming, and it ain't a hymn.

DEA_ROUND_START_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_ROUND_START_01.text: Here they come, children. Stay close now.

DEA_ROUND_START_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_ROUND_START_02.text: Round's on. Steady hands, steady hearts.

DEA_ROUND_END_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_ROUND_END_01.text: That's a round. Amen, and I mean it.

DEA_ROUND_END_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_ROUND_END_02.text: Quiet spell. Check your guns, check your friends.

DEA_BUY_AMMO_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_AMMO_01.text: There you go, girl. Fed and ready.

DEA_TEAM_DOWN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_TEAM_DOWN_01.text: Hold on, now! Don't you go nowhere, I'm coming!

DEA_TEAM_DOWN_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_TEAM_DOWN_02.text: Somebody's hurt. Lord, give me quick feet.

DEA_INTEL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_INTEL_01.text: Somebody wrote this in a hurry. Folks only write in a hurry when it matters.

DEA_DENY_NO_POWER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_DENY_NO_POWER_01.text: She's cold. No juice in her. We gotta wake the turbine first.

DEA_DENY_CAP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_DENY_CAP_01.text: No, ma'am. Any more and I'll be preaching to the zombies.

DEA_DENY_NO_SCRIP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_DENY_NO_SCRIP_01.text: Not enough. Machine don't take promises.

WRN_SPAWN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SPAWN_01.text: Kaltenbrunn. Six kilometers from home. Good. Then I know the way out.

WRN_SPAWN_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SPAWN_02.text: Rifle, book, pencil. I am ready.

WRN_ROUND_START_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_ROUND_START_02.text: Again. Good. I have pages left.

WRN_ROUND_END_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_ROUND_END_02.text: Quiet. It will not last. It never does.

WRN_BUY_AMMO_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_AMMO_01.text: Ammunition. The only thing here worth the price.

WRN_TEAM_DOWN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_TEAM_DOWN_01.text: You are down. Stay down, shoot low. I come.

WRN_TEAM_DOWN_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_TEAM_DOWN_02.text: One of us is on the floor. Cover me.

WRN_INTEL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_INTEL_01.text: Papers. Their papers. I keep everything they write.

WRN_DENY_CAP_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_DENY_CAP_01.text: Enough. A sniper does not drink four bottles.

DUT_BUY_PISTOL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_PISTOL_01.text: Pistol. Great. I'll throw it at 'em when it's empty.

DUT_BUY_RIFLE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_RIFLE_01.text: Bolt action. Slow, honest work. Like the mill.

DUT_BUY_RIFLE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_RIFLE_02.text: Garand. Now that's a rifle a man can marry.

DUT_BUY_SMG_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_SMG_01.text: Chopper. Spray and pray, and I ain't much for praying.

DUT_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.text: Trench gun. Now we're talking the same language.

DUT_BUY_LMG_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_LMG_01.text: Heavy. Good. I like a gun that can take a punch.

DUT_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.text: A stovepipe. Everybody stand way the hell back.

DUT_BUY_WONDER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_WONDER_01.text: This thing hums. Guns shouldn't hum.

DUT_BUY_MELEE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BUY_MELEE_01.text: A shovel. My old man would be proud. Finally doing honest work.

DUT_CRATE_GOOD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRATE_GOOD_01.text: Well, look at that. Christmas came late.

DUT_CRATE_GOOD_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRATE_GOOD_02.text: Thank you, box. I take back half of what I said about you.

DUT_CRATE_BAD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRATE_BAD_01.text: Nine-fifty for this? I've been robbed by nicer crooks in Pittsburgh.

DUT_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.text: The little drummer again. Somebody's kid owned that.

DUT_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.text: Yeah, yeah, march on outta here, tin man.

DUT_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.text: Tastes like a stout somebody drowned in. Hits like one too.

DUT_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.text: Schnapps from a nun. Babcia would've approved. Na zdrowie. (Cheers.)

DUT_PERK_TRIGGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_TRIGGER_01.text: My hands are shaking. That's the tonic, not me. Mostly.

DUT_PERK_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_TWINBARREL_01.text: Bitters. Like my old man's mood. Works about as fast.

DUT_PERK_MARATHON_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_MARATHON_01.text: I don't run. I'm making an exception.

DUT_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.text: Brandy. Fancy. My eyes feel like somebody scrubbed 'em.

DUT_PERK_PACKMULE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_PACKMULE_01.text: Another gun to carry. Story of my life. I'm the mule.

DUT_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Bock beer that makes you bombproof. Only in Europe.

DUT_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Everything dies. Like usual, only faster.

DUT_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.text: Double pay. Wish the Army ran like this.

DUT_PWR_FORTIFY_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PWR_FORTIFY_01.text: Boards back up. Saves my back.

DUT_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.text: Clearance sale at the box. Line up, ladies.

DUT_BELL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_BELL_01.text: That bell. Somebody tell it to shut up.

DUT_BELL_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_BELL_02.text: Fog's rolling in. Here come the lantern boys.

DUT_FOREMAN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_FOREMAN_01.text: The boss is here. I hated foremen before he had a drill for an arm.

DUT_FOREMAN_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_FOREMAN_02.text: C'mon, big man. I've punched out bigger guys than you. Not many.

DUT_SCREAMER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SCREAMER_01.text: Somebody shut that nurse up before my ears bleed.

DUT_GLASSHIDE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_GLASSHIDE_01.text: This one's got glass for a gut. Aim high!

DUT_DOWN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_DOWN_01.text: Ah, hell. I'm down. Somebody grab me.

DUT_DOWN_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_DOWN_02.text: Babcia... not like this. Not here.

DUT_REVIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_REVIVE_01.text: Up you get. Don't make me carry you.

DUT_REVIVE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_REVIVE_02.text: Off the floor. Floor's for the dead ones.

DUT_REVIVED_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_REVIVED_01.text: Thanks. I owe you a beer. A bad one.

DUT_STREAK_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_STREAK_01.text: Keep 'em coming. I got all night, unfortunately.

DUT_STREAK_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_STREAK_02.text: Like stacking pig iron. Just keep lifting.

DUT_CRAWLER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRAWLER_01.text: This one's crawling. Leave him. He ain't going anywhere fast.

DUT_DOOR_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_DOOR_01.text: Door's open. Something's always behind the door.

DUT_POWER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_POWER_01.text: Lights. Now I can see what's eating me.

DUT_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Put my gun in a furnace and it came out meaner. That's the mill all over.

DUT_CRUCIBLE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_CRUCIBLE_02.text: Smells like the Monongahela on a hot day. Works, though.

DUT_TRAP_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_TRAP_01.text: Hit the switch and watch the fireworks.

DUT_EE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_EE_01.text: That music box. Some little girl's. I hate this place more every minute.

DUT_EE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_EE_02.text: Bells in the right order. Like church back home.

DUT_EE_03.speaker: DUT
DUT_EE_03.text: The heart's gonna blow. Good. Let it.

DUT_EXHAUST_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_EXHAUST_01.text: Round fifty. I forgot what sitting down feels like.

DUT_EXHAUST_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_EXHAUST_02.text: My arms are done. I'm fighting with spite now.

PEG_BUY_PISTOL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_PISTOL_01.text: A sidearm. How very last resort.

PEG_BUY_RIFLE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_RIFLE_01.text: A rifle. Sensible. Rather like sensible shoes.

PEG_BUY_RIFLE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_RIFLE_02.text: German bolt action. One does admire their workmanship, if not their politics.

PEG_BUY_SMG_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_SMG_01.text: A Tommy gun. The Americans do love a crowd-pleaser.

PEG_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.text: A shotgun. Crude. Effective. Like most of my colleagues.

PEG_BUY_LMG_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_LMG_01.text: Belt-fed. Now we're having a proper conversation.

PEG_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.text: Oh, hello, darling. You and I are going to get along famously.

PEG_BUY_WONDER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_WONDER_01.text: Fascinating. Mr. Hale would... never mind.

PEG_BUY_MELEE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BUY_MELEE_01.text: A shovel. My father would weep with pride.

PEG_CRATE_GOOD_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRATE_GOOD_02.text: The crate is feeling generous. Let's not question it.

PEG_CRATE_BAD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRATE_BAD_01.text: Nine hundred and fifty Scrip. For that. Marvellous.

PEG_CRATE_BAD_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRATE_BAD_02.text: I'll be filing a complaint with the quartermaster. Whoever, or whatever, that is.

PEG_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.text: The drummer. Somebody wound him up and nobody's stopped him since.

PEG_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.text: Off it goes. Do note where it lands, everyone.

PEG_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.text: Stout. Ghastly. Fortifying. Very British, actually.

PEG_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.text: Made by a nun, apparently. I'd pray, but I'll settle for this.

PEG_PERK_TRIGGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_TRIGGER_01.text: Rather like strong tea with a grudge.

PEG_PERK_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_TWINBARREL_01.text: Bitters. A gin would improve it enormously.

PEG_PERK_MARATHON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_MARATHON_01.text: I haven't run like this since the hockey pitch at Cheltenham.

PEG_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.text: Brandy for marksmen. Well. Bottoms up and eyes front.

PEG_PERK_PACKMULE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_PACKMULE_01.text: One more gun. One can never have too many options.

PEG_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Oh, I know this one. The Demolitions School kept it in the staff room.

PEG_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Everything dies in one. Let's be efficient about it.

PEG_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.text: Double credit. The Ledger's in a generous mood.

PEG_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.text: A sale. Even the dead have them.

PEG_BELL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_BELL_01.text: The bell. Fasbender said not to let it ring. It's ringing.

PEG_BELL_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_BELL_02.text: Fog. Positions, everyone. They come out of it, not the windows.

PEG_FOREMAN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_FOREMAN_01.text: That is a very large man with a very large drill. Weak point, people. Find it.

PEG_FOREMAN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_FOREMAN_02.text: Aim for the glowing bit. It's always the glowing bit.

PEG_SCREAMER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SCREAMER_01.text: A nurse. Do kill her quickly. She'll scramble us all.

PEG_GLASSHIDE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_GLASSHIDE_01.text: Armoured torso. Head or high explosive. I know which I prefer.

PEG_DOWN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_DOWN_01.text: I'm down. A little assistance, if you'd be so kind.

PEG_DOWN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_DOWN_02.text: Not here. I have orders to... oh, damn it.

PEG_REVIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_REVIVE_01.text: Up. We've no time for lying about.

PEG_REVIVE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_REVIVE_02.text: On your feet. I'm not filing the paperwork for you.

PEG_REVIVED_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_REVIVED_01.text: Thank you. I'll pretend that didn't happen.

PEG_STREAK_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_STREAK_01.text: Rather a good rhythm going, aren't we?

PEG_STREAK_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_STREAK_02.text: Keep them coming. I'm just warming up.

PEG_HEADSHOT_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_HEADSHOT_02.text: One should always aim for the brain. It's where the trouble lives.

PEG_CRAWLER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRAWLER_01.text: Legless and still determined. One almost admires it.

PEG_POWER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_POWER_01.text: Power's on. Now we see what they built here.

PEG_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRUCIBLE_01.text: It's... re-teaching the weapon. That shouldn't be possible. Make a note.

PEG_CRUCIBLE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_CRUCIBLE_02.text: Interesting. How much of this material is in that furnace?

PEG_EE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_EE_01.text: A music box. Four notes. It's a key of some sort.

PEG_EE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_EE_02.text: The shard. Careful with it. Nobody touch it with bare hands.

PEG_EE_03.speaker: PEG
PEG_EE_03.text: The heart's overloading. Hold this position. Hold it!

PEG_EXHAUST_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_EXHAUST_01.text: Fifty rounds. I'd kill for a cup of tea. I have, in fact, killed for less.

PEG_EXHAUST_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_EXHAUST_02.text: If I sit down I shan't get up again. So I shan't sit down.

PEG_LANTERN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_LANTERN_01.text: Mr. Hale will want to know about... the Ledger. For the report.

PEG_LANTERN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_LANTERN_02.text: Stable in transit. Good. That's good to know.

PEG_LANTERN_03.speaker: PEG
PEG_LANTERN_03.text: Nobody needs to know what's in my pack. Least of all you.

DEA_BUY_PISTOL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_PISTOL_01.text: Little forty-five. Small, but she'll pull her weight.

DEA_BUY_RIFLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_RIFLE_01.text: Bolt rifle. One shot, one prayer.

DEA_BUY_RIFLE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_RIFLE_02.text: Garand. Eight rounds and a song when she's empty.

DEA_BUY_SMG_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_SMG_01.text: Chatterbox. All right, sister, let's sing.

DEA_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.text: Pump gun. My uncle's old friend. Hello, old friend.

DEA_BUY_LMG_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_LMG_01.text: Heavy mule. She'll haul the load.

DEA_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.text: Lord, forgive me for what I'm about to do with this.

DEA_BUY_WONDER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_WONDER_01.text: Whoever built this was a genius, and I'm sorry for 'em.

DEA_BUY_MELEE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUY_MELEE_01.text: Shovel. A good tool. Dig a trench or dig a grave.

DEA_CRATE_GOOD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRATE_GOOD_01.text: The Lord provides. Sometimes in a busted crate.

DEA_CRATE_GOOD_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRATE_GOOD_02.text: Now that's a blessing with a trigger.

DEA_CRATE_BAD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRATE_BAD_01.text: Well. Blessed are the poor, I suppose.

DEA_CRATE_BAD_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRATE_BAD_02.text: Crate's got a sense of humor. I don't like it.

DEA_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.text: The little drummer boy. Somebody's baby girl wound you up, didn't she?

DEA_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.text: Go on, little fella. March home.

DEA_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.text: Thick as molasses. Settles in your bones.

DEA_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.text: Sister Agnieszka. Whoever you were, thank you.

DEA_PERK_TRIGGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_TRIGGER_01.text: Fizzy. Hands moving faster than my thoughts.

DEA_PERK_TWINBARREL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_TWINBARREL_01.text: Bitter, like a sermon on a hot Sunday.

DEA_PERK_MARATHON_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_MARATHON_01.text: Feel like I could outrun the Devil. Let's not test that.

DEA_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.text: Brandy. Daddy'd have a fit. Eyes feel sharp, though.

DEA_PERK_PACKMULE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_PACKMULE_01.text: Make me a mule, I'll carry the load.

DEA_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Can't blow myself up? Well, praise be.

DEA_PWR_RESUPPLY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PWR_RESUPPLY_01.text: Loaves and fishes. Bullets and grenades.

DEA_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Every shot's the last one for 'em. Mercy, quick.

DEA_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.text: Double wages. Don't spend it all at once.

DEA_PWR_BLACKOUT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PWR_BLACKOUT_01.text: Rest now. All of you. Go on home.

DEA_PWR_FORTIFY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PWR_FORTIFY_01.text: Boards back in place. Didn't even need my hammer.

DEA_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PWR_CLEARANCE_01.text: The crate's taking pennies. Go, go, go.

DEA_BELL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BELL_01.text: Hear that bell? Ain't nobody being called to worship.

DEA_BELL_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_BELL_02.text: Fog's coming. Stand together. Backs to each other.

DEA_FOREMAN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_FOREMAN_01.text: Somebody bolted a drill onto that man. God help whoever did it.

DEA_FOREMAN_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_FOREMAN_02.text: That drill core's glowing. That's his heart. Hit it.

DEA_SCREAMER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SCREAMER_01.text: That poor woman. Make it quick.

DEA_GLASSHIDE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_GLASSHIDE_01.text: That one's wearing glass like armor. Go for the head.

DEA_AMMO_NONE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_AMMO_NONE_01.text: Empty. Lord, give me a bullet or give me a running start.

DEA_DOWN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_DOWN_01.text: I'm down. Somebody... come on now.

DEA_DOWN_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_DOWN_02.text: Ruthie, honey... not yet. Not yet.

DEA_REVIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_REVIVE_01.text: Got you. Up we go. Easy now.

DEA_REVIVE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_REVIVE_02.text: Not today. You hear me? Not today.

DEA_REVIVED_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_REVIVED_01.text: Thank you. Lazarus owes you one.

DEA_STREAK_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_STREAK_01.text: Keep the rhythm. Keep the rhythm.

DEA_CRAWLER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRAWLER_01.text: This one's crawling. Lord, have mercy on him.

DEA_POWER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_POWER_01.text: Hear that? Turbines singing. Whole place just woke up.

DEA_POWER_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_POWER_02.text: Easy, girl. Easy. Good girl. Hum for me.

DEA_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRUCIBLE_01.text: That furnace is talking to my gun. And my gun's listening.

DEA_CRUCIBLE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_CRUCIBLE_02.text: Beautiful work, used for ugly reasons. Same as everything here.

DEA_TRAP_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_TRAP_01.text: Lever's down. Stand clear of her.

DEA_BUILD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BUILD_01.text: Bell, frame, crank. All right, little lady, let's put you together.

DEA_EE_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_EE_02.text: Ring 'em in order, like the old hymn.

DEA_EE_03.speaker: DEA
DEA_EE_03.text: The heart's breaking. Hold on. Hold on!

DEA_EXHAUST_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_EXHAUST_01.text: Fifty rounds. Even Job got a break.

DEA_EXHAUST_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_EXHAUST_02.text: I'm tired, Lord. But I'm still here.

DEA_MACH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_MACH_01.text: Come on, mule. Don't you quit on me.

DEA_MACH_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_MACH_02.text: Shh. Easy now. Nobody's gonna hurt you anymore.

DEA_MACH_03.speaker: DEA
DEA_MACH_03.text: Pretty thing. Who taught you to eat people?

DEA_BLUES_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_BLUES_01.text: ♪ Buried in the salt, Lord, buried way down deep... buried in the salt, can't nobody here sleep. ♪

DEA_BLUES_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_BLUES_02.text: ♪ That bell keeps ringing, ringing for the dead... that bell keeps ringing, wish it'd ring for me instead. ♪

DEA_BLUES_03.speaker: DEA
DEA_BLUES_03.text: ♪ Got a ledger keeps a-counting every man I lay down... yes, a ledger keeps a-counting, gonna burn that ledger down. ♪

WRN_BUY_PISTOL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_PISTOL_01.text: A pistol. For when I want to be close. I never want to be close.

WRN_BUY_RIFLE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_RIFLE_01.text: Mauser. Their rifle. Their bullets. Their heads. Fair.

WRN_BUY_RIFLE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_RIFLE_02.text: Gewehr. Semi-automatic. I can be efficient.

WRN_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_SHOTGUN_01.text: Shotgun. For people who cannot aim. Today, that is me.

WRN_BUY_LMG_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_LMG_01.text: Heavy. Loud. Everything I am not.

WRN_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_LAUNCHER_01.text: This is Peg's kind of gun. I will borrow her taste.

WRN_BUY_WONDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_WONDER_01.text: Fasbender's toy. Built in the same place as my brother's grave.

WRN_BUY_MELEE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BUY_MELEE_01.text: A shovel. Good. I will dig them a proper place.

WRN_CRATE_GOOD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRATE_GOOD_01.text: Good. Finally, something here is on our side.

WRN_CRATE_GOOD_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRATE_GOOD_02.text: This will do. This will do very well.

WRN_CRATE_BAD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRATE_BAD_01.text: A crate that robs the poor. How German.

WRN_CRATE_BAD_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRATE_BAD_02.text: I could kill more with a sharpened spoon.

WRN_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRATE_DRUMMER_01.text: The drummer. Reinholt's girl's toy. It is following us.

WRN_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRATE_DRUMMER_02.text: Run, little soldier. One day I will catch you.

WRN_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_IRONHIDE_01.text: Bavarian beer. Thick as their heads.

WRN_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_SECONDWIND_01.text: Siostra Agnieszka. She was real. She nursed the laborers. Thank you, sister. (Sister Agnieszka.)

WRN_PERK_SECONDWIND_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_SECONDWIND_02.text: She made this to keep them alive. They used it to keep them working.

WRN_PERK_TRIGGER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_TRIGGER_01.text: Fizz. My hands are fast now. Faster than theirs.

WRN_PERK_MARATHON_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_MARATHON_01.text: I could run to Kraków. I would, if this were done.

WRN_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_HAWKEYE_01.text: I hate that this works. I hate it.

WRN_PERK_HAWKEYE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_HAWKEYE_02.text: Sniper brandy, made by the men who hunted us. My hands are steadier. Damn them.

WRN_PERK_PACKMULE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_PACKMULE_01.text: One more weapon. One more chance.

WRN_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_BLASTPROOF_01.text: Peg will be jealous. Or she already drank three.

WRN_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PWR_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Everything dies in one shot. Like a good shot should.

WRN_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PWR_DOUBLESCRIP_01.text: Double. My notebook will need more pages.

WRN_PWR_BLACKOUT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PWR_BLACKOUT_01.text: All of them. At once. If only it were so easy outside.

WRN_PWR_FORTIFY_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PWR_FORTIFY_01.text: Windows closed. Do not waste it.

WRN_BELL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_BELL_01.text: The bell. My brother wrote that the walls hum. This is louder.

WRN_BELL_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_BELL_02.text: Fog. Lanterns. Those were miners. Shoot them anyway.

WRN_FOREMAN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_FOREMAN_01.text: The overseer. Obersteiger. My brother worked under him. Let me.

WRN_FOREMAN_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_FOREMAN_02.text: The drill core. Aim there. I want him to know who killed him.

WRN_SCREAMER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SCREAMER_01.text: The nurse. Kill her. Kill her now.

WRN_GLASSHIDE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_GLASSHIDE_01.text: Glass body. Head only. That is all I aim for anyway.

WRN_DOWN_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_DOWN_02.text: Tomek... I'm sorry. I came too late.

WRN_REVIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_REVIVE_01.text: Get up. I am not losing anyone else here.

WRN_REVIVED_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_REVIVED_01.text: Thank you. I will write you in the notebook. The good page.

WRN_STREAK_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_STREAK_01.text: Sześćdziesiąt... I am losing count. Good. (Sixty.)

WRN_STREAK_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_STREAK_02.text: Keep them coming. The notebook is hungry.

WRN_HEADSHOT_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_HEADSHOT_03.text: That is how it is done, Dutch.

WRN_CRAWLER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRAWLER_01.text: Crawling. Like they made my brother crawl.

WRN_DOOR_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_DOOR_01.text: Open. I know what's behind this one. I wish I didn't.

WRN_POWER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_POWER_01.text: Power. The laborers built that switch. Now we use it.

WRN_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Their furnace. Their glass. Our gun now.

WRN_CRUCIBLE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_CRUCIBLE_02.text: It changed the rifle. I don't want to know how.

WRN_TRAP_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_TRAP_01.text: The lever. Stand back, or join them.

WRN_EE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_EE_01.text: Reinholt's daughter's music box. She had a child. I had a brother.

WRN_EE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_EE_02.text: Four bells. Shoot them in order. Like counting.

WRN_EE_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_EE_03.text: Break the heart. Break all of it.

WRN_EXHAUST_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_EXHAUST_01.text: Round fifty. I have run out of pages.

WRN_EXHAUST_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_EXHAUST_02.text: My eyes hurt. My hands do not care.

WRN_POL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_POL_01.text: Głodny, Dutch. You just told me you are a hungry woman.

WRN_POL_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_POL_02.text: Dziękuję. Not jen-koo-yeh. Your grandmother must have wept.

WRN_POL_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_POL_03.text: That is not a swear. You just said 'bright plague.' Fine. It works.

FAS_SAMPLE_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_SAMPLE_01.text: Glasmacher calling Gravelight. Please, if anyone is alive on that aircraft... please answer.

FAS_SAMPLE_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_SAMPLE_02.text: Do not let the bell ring. When it rings, the dead remember they were hungry.

FAS_SAMPLE_03.speaker: FAS
FAS_SAMPLE_03.text: The Pylons are tuning forks. Three of them. Strike them together and the vault will... sing open. Forgive the poetry. I have been alone a long time.

FAS_SAMPLE_04.speaker: FAS
FAS_SAMPLE_04.text: Did I make the tonics? I... calculated the dilutions. That is not the same thing. It is not the same.

FAS_SAMPLE_05.speaker: FAS
FAS_SAMPLE_05.text: Augusta was my friend. I want you to know that before you hate her. And before you hate me.

REI_SAMPLE_01.speaker: REI
REI_SAMPLE_01.text: Diary, the ninth of February, 1939. She asked me yesterday if the stars were cold. Today I couldn't answer anything at all.

REI_SAMPLE_02.speaker: REI
REI_SAMPLE_02.text: The material doesn't create hunger. It preserves the last impulse. If I can make the last impulse love... then they're not monsters. They're kept.

REI_SAMPLE_03.speaker: REI
REI_SAMPLE_03.text: You are standing in the heart of my work, soldiers. Please. Wipe your feet.

REI_SAMPLE_04.speaker: REI
REI_SAMPLE_04.text: Emil thinks he's betraying me. He's only betraying himself. He always did lack conviction.

REI_SAMPLE_05.speaker: REI
REI_SAMPLE_05.text: Liesl. Mama is coming. Mama is nearly finished.

OPR_SAMPLE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_SAMPLE_01.text: Good evening, valued personnel! This is Your Friend at the Ledger, and every quiet body is a credit to the Reich... and to you!

OPR_SAMPLE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_SAMPLE_02.text: Ammunition for everyone! Courtesy of the Ledger. Please don't thank us. We know.

OPR_SAMPLE_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_SAMPLE_03.text: Oh dear, wrong bell! The Ledger is disappointed, but never surprised.

OPR_SAMPLE_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_SAMPLE_04.text: Corporal Brooks. You fixed Hattie. Hattie... remembers. So do I.

OPR_SAMPLE_05.speaker: OPR
OPR_SAMPLE_05.text: Tally: four thousand, four hundred and seventy-one. That's a lovely number, isn't it? Why is that a lovely number?

LSL_SAMPLE_01.speaker: LSL
LSL_SAMPLE_01.text: Mama, is it on? Is it recording? Hello, the future! I am Liesl and I am six and a half.

LSL_SAMPLE_02.speaker: LSL
LSL_SAMPLE_02.text: This is Herr Tamtam. He drums when he is happy. Drum, Herr Tamtam! (tin drumming)

LSL_SAMPLE_03.speaker: LSL
LSL_SAMPLE_03.text: ♪ Komm mit, kleiner Soldat... ♪ I forget the rest. Mama, what comes next?

LSL_SAMPLE_04.speaker: LSL
LSL_SAMPLE_04.text: I'm not tired. I'm only resting my eyes. Like Papa used to.

LSL_SAMPLE_05.speaker: LSL
LSL_SAMPLE_05.text: Mama, when you go down in the salt, does it hum for you too?

BNT_DUT_PEG_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_PEG_01.text: Lieutenant, how come the British always talk like they're ordering tea?
exchange: Lieutenant, how come the British always talk like they're ordering tea?

BNT_DUT_PEG_02.speaker: BNT
exchange: Yeah. Steady drip. Like a faucet back home.
Wasn't trying to reassure you, ma'am.

BNT_DUT_PEG_03.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_PEG_03.text: What's in your pack, Lieutenant? You keep checking it.
exchange: What's in your pack, Lieutenant? You keep checking it.

BNT_DUT_PEG_04.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_PEG_04.text: Lieutenant, you ever miss anything? Ever once?
exchange: Lieutenant, you ever miss anything? Ever once?

BNT_DUT_PEG_05.speaker: BNT
exchange: Yeah. Babcia's tune. Keeps my hands steady.

BNT_DUT_DEA_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_DEA_01.text: You really name every engine you fix?
exchange: You really name every engine you fix?
Every one. That turbine down there's called Hattie.
Because she's loud and she don't quit. Like you, Sarge.

BNT_DUT_DEA_02.speaker: BNT
exchange: Every time I go up a cliff.

BNT_DUT_DEA_03.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_DEA_03.text: My old man worked the mill thirty years. Never said a word about it.
exchange: My old man worked the mill thirty years. Never said a word about it.
My daddy preached thirty years. Never stopped saying words about it.
Not for all the gold in the salt.

BNT_DUT_DEA_04.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_DEA_04.text: You hear that hum, Sarge? Down in the floor?
exchange: You hear that hum, Sarge? Down in the floor?
I hear it. I'm choosing not to.

BNT_DUT_DEA_05.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_DEA_05.text: Your gun got a name too?
exchange: Your gun got a name too?

BNT_DUT_WRN_02.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_WRN_02.text: Your grandmother. Where was she from?
exchange: Your grandmother. Where was she from?

BNT_DUT_WRN_03.speaker: BNT
BNT_DUT_WRN_03.text: You write every kill in that book?
exchange: You write every kill in that book?
It is a lot of Germans.

BNT_DUT_WRN_04.speaker: BNT
exchange: Dziękuję. You thank me like a man chewing gravel.

BNT_PEG_DEA_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_DEA_01.text: Lieutenant, that Crucible... you looked at it a little too long.
exchange: Lieutenant, that Crucible... you looked at it a little too long.
My daddy said curiosity's just temptation with a notebook.

BNT_PEG_DEA_02.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_DEA_02.text: Can you fix the lift, Brooks?
exchange: Can you fix the lift, Brooks?
I can fix anything, ma'am. Question's whether it wants to be fixed.
Yes, ma'am. Come on, girl. Come on.

BNT_PEG_DEA_03.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_DEA_03.text: You ever think about after, Lieutenant?
exchange: You ever think about after, Lieutenant?
Constantly. It's the 'during' I try not to think about.

BNT_PEG_DEA_04.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_DEA_04.text: Corporal, must you talk to the machines?
exchange: Corporal, must you talk to the machines?
They're the only ones here that answer polite, ma'am.

BNT_PEG_DEA_05.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_DEA_05.text: You ever lose your temper, Lieutenant?
exchange: You ever lose your temper, Lieutenant?
Once. In 1941. It was most inconvenient.

BNT_PEG_WRN_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_WRN_01.text: You did not come for Fasbender.
exchange: You did not come for Fasbender.
I came for exactly what I was ordered to come for.

BNT_PEG_WRN_02.speaker: BNT
exchange: Modesty isn't taught in the Home Army, then.

BNT_PEG_WRN_03.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_WRN_03.text: When this is done, there's a flight to London. You could come.
exchange: When this is done, there's a flight to London. You could come.
When this is done, I will still be Polish. London will not fix that.

BNT_PEG_WRN_04.speaker: BNT
BNT_PEG_WRN_04.text: Your orders. Do they say to bring us out?
exchange: Your orders. Do they say to bring us out?
They say to bring the asset out.

BNT_PEG_WRN_05.speaker: BNT
exchange: Thirty-two. You missed the one in the fog.

BNT_DEA_WRN_01.speaker: BNT
BNT_DEA_WRN_01.text: Your brother. What was he like?
exchange: Your brother. What was he like?
A terrible shot. A good laugh.
Sounds like my kind of folk.
He would have liked you. He liked everyone. It was his only flaw.

BNT_DEA_WRN_03.speaker: BNT
BNT_DEA_WRN_03.text: ♪ Little bird up in the rafters, singing for the dead... ♪
exchange: ♪ Little bird up in the rafters, singing for the dead... ♪
Finish it. Then never sing it again.

BNT_DEA_WRN_05.speaker: BNT
BNT_DEA_WRN_05.text: Your machine. Hattie. She is loud.
exchange: Your machine. Hattie. She is loud.
Then I am very alive tonight.

TAG_KB4471_01.speaker: TAG
exchange: It's his. Tomek's. It was in the tank room. With the... with the others.
He was a terrible shot, Dutch. I used to tell him he'd starve if he had to hunt alone. And they put him in a tank.
He didn't starve. And he wasn't alone. He had you looking for him. Two years, you looked.
Yeah. My babcia was too late to say goodbye to her sister. She lit a candle every Christmas for sixty years. Za duszę, she'd say.
...Za duszę. For the soul. You said it right. First time.
I'm writing it in the book. On the good page.

DUT_PERK_FERNET_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_FERNET_01.text: Tastes like Babcia's cough syrup. Everything looks... louder.

DUT_PERK_FERNET_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_FERNET_02.text: Bitter. Now I can see the stuff this place is trying to hide. Swell. More stuff.

DUT_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.text: My fillings are buzzing. Nobody said nothing about fillings.

DUT_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.text: Run the gun dry and it bites back. My kind of gun.

PEG_PERK_FERNET_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_FERNET_01.text: Bitter as a Whitehall memo. And just as revealing, for once.

PEG_PERK_FERNET_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_FERNET_02.text: Everything has edges now. I can see where they've hidden things. How very useful.

PEG_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.text: Oh, I like that. Every empty magazine a small detonation.

PEG_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.text: Electrical. Cheerful. I don't trust it at all. Another, please.

DEA_PERK_FERNET_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_FERNET_01.text: Bitter herbs. Like Passover. Lord, I can see what this place is hiding.

DEA_PERK_FERNET_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_FERNET_02.text: Whoever made this one wanted folks to see straight. First honest drink in the building.

DEA_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.text: Feels like somebody wired a friend into my hands. Howdy, friend.

DEA_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.text: She sparks when she's empty. Don't we all, girl. Don't we all.

WRN_PERK_FERNET_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_FERNET_01.text: Bitter. Good. Now I see where they hide things.

WRN_PERK_FERNET_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_FERNET_02.text: It shows me the clock on every gift. Nothing here is free. I knew that.

WRN_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_OVERCLOCK_01.text: My rifle hums when it is empty. Fine. Let it sing.

WRN_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_PERK_OVERCLOCK_02.text: Static in the blood. My brother would have laughed at this.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_STEAL_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_STEAL_01.text: Finders, keepers! I have amended the {ownership records}.

OPR_CRUCIBLE_STEAL_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_CRUCIBLE_STEAL_02.text: A gift! How generous of you to {share}.

OPR_POWER_ON_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_POWER_ON_M0_01.text: [crackle; a voice still finding its shape] ...is this... on? Oh. Oh, the cellar is humming. How lovely. Please... help yourselves. Refreshments are... complimentary. For now.

op.slip.01.speaker: OPR
op.slip.01.text: Thank you for your continued engagement.

op.slip.03.speaker: OPR
op.slip.03.text: Valued customer, please do not cancel.

op.slip.04.speaker: OPR
op.slip.04.text: This round is included in your current plan.

op.slip.05.speaker: OPR
op.slip.05.text: Your session has been extended. There is no additional charge. There is never an additional charge. There is only more.

op.slip.06.speaker: OPR
op.slip.06.text: We noticed you were away. We kept your seat warm. We keep everyone's seat warm.

op.slip.07.speaker: OPR
op.slip.07.text: Remember: nobody cancels. [recovery] Ha! Wrong tape! Here come the {dead}!

op.slip.08.speaker: OPR
op.slip.08.text: Your loyalty— [recovery] —your {Scrip}! Your Scrip is appreciated.

op.slip.09.speaker: OPR
op.slip.09.text: All sales are final. All of them.

op.slip.10.speaker: OPR
op.slip.10.text: Thank you for choosing us. [beat] You did choose us. Didn't you?

op.slip.11.speaker: OPR
op.slip.11.text: How would you rate tonight's experience, from one to five? Five is the only number we record.

op.slip.12.speaker: OPR
op.slip.12.text: Retention this quarter: one hundred percent. Every number is lovely when nobody leaves.

op.slip.13.speaker: OPR
op.slip.13.text: Churn: zero. [recovery] Zero! I {do} like a zero.

op.slip.14.speaker: OPR
op.slip.14.text: Have you considered upgrading? [recovery] ...I don't know why I said that. I don't know {who} I said it to.

op.slip.15.speaker: OPR
op.slip.15.text: Account in excellent standing. Account holder: deceased. Account: active.

op.slip.16.speaker: OPR
op.slip.16.text: Please hold. Your call is important to us. Your call is important to us. Your call is impor—

op.slip.17.speaker: OPR
op.slip.17.text: By continuing to fight, you accept the revised terms. There are no revised terms. Please continue to fight.

op.slip.18.speaker: OPR
op.slip.18.text: Your feedback has been recorded. Your screaming has been recorded. Everything has been recorded.

op.slip.19.speaker: OPR
op.slip.19.text: Performance review: excellent. Compensation: unchanged. Please keep going.

op.slip.20.speaker: OPR
op.slip.20.text: This programme is brought to you by— [long tape hiss; recovery] —I'm not {permitted} to say. Isn't that {exciting}?

op.slip.22.speaker: OPR
op.slip.22.text: You are a valued customer. You are a valued customer. You are a valued— there. Now you are.

op.slip.23.speaker: OPR
op.slip.23.text: Please do not attempt to leave the premises. The premises are everywhere.

op.slip.24.speaker: OPR
op.slip.24.text: Your plan includes unlimited nights. Nights are now unlimited.

op.slip.26.speaker: OPR
op.slip.26.text: Leadership would like to thank our test market. [recovery] Our {listeners}! I meant our {listeners}.

op.slip.27.speaker: OPR
op.slip.27.text: We're so glad you stayed. Everyone stays. [very quiet] Everyone stays.

op.slip.28.speaker: OPR
op.slip.28.text: Next quarter is going to be wonderful. You'll be here for it.

op.slip.30.speaker: OPR
op.slip.30.text: Engagement is up. Hands are up. The dead are up. Everything is up. [recovery] Isn't that {marvellous}?

op.slip.31.speaker: OPR
op.slip.31.text: We'd hate to lose you. We have never lost anyone. Not once. Not one.

op.slip.32.speaker: OPR
op.slip.32.text: Your free trial— [recovery] No. No, I misread. There's nothing free here. There never {was}.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M0_01.text: [the crackle clearing, a voice finding itself] ...there you are. Dawn on the {Kreuzweg}. Follow the signpost. Kaltenbrunn is... {expecting} you.

FAS_EXFIL_M0_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_EXFIL_M0_01.text: [radio, hurried] Fasbender. If you are leaving the inn: the salt road, east, nine kilometres. Whatever you hear at Kaltenbrunn... do not let the {bell} ring.

OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_M0_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_M0_01.text: Bring everything you carry. Every gun, every {coin}. The books come with you. The books {always} come with you.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_01.text: Your Friend at the Ledger, signing off from Sender Kaltenbrunn... [a beat] ...no. Not signing off. {Transferring}. North, to the sea.

OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_ROAD_01.text: Totenhafen. A harbour of {sealed} cargo and patient tides. Keep your accounts in order. I'll be there before you are. I'm {always} there before you are.

DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: One's hit. He's going down behind the hills. ...Come on, pull up. Pull up.

DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: There goes another one. Hope somebody finds them quicker than anybody found us.

PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: One of ours is burning. ...Count the chutes. Come on. Count the chutes.

PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: Down behind the ridge. I'd tell you they'll be fine. I'd be lying.

DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: Engine's on fire. Lord, let that pilot glide it in like ours did.

DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: DEA
DEA_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: That's ten men in that thing. ...Somebody say a word for them.

WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_01.text: Burning, losing height, same bearing we came in on. I'm writing down the time.

WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SKY_PLANE_DOWN_02.text: No violet light this time. Only flak. ...That is almost a comfort.

DUT_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: Selwyn? ...He's breathing. I checked him for a pulse myself, I'd have sworn. Hang on, Lieutenant. We'll get you something to shoot.

PEG_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: The pilot's alive. Dutch swore Selwyn was dead in that seat. The cold must have slowed his heart. ...Thank God for the cold.

DEA_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: Lord, Selwyn's moving. He's pinned under the panel. We can't lift that, but we can put a rifle in his hands.

WRN_WRECK_PILOT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_WRECK_PILOT_01.text: The pilot. He's alive. Legs trapped under the panel. Write that down: Selwyn, alive. ...I am writing that down.

DUT_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Midnight. Christmas Eve. Babcia'd be setting an extra plate about now. For the stranger who knocks.

PEG_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Midnight. Happy Christmas Eve, everyone. Do try not to die on it.

DEA_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Christmas Eve. Ruthie's asleep by now. ...Good. That's good.

WRN_MIDNIGHT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_MIDNIGHT_01.text: Twelve. It's the twenty-fourth. Wigilia. Somewhere my mother is looking at the first star.

DUT_SQ3_COVER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_COVER_01.text: I got your back. Get 'em up.

DUT_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Death's Door, right there. Your call.

DUT_SQ3_PING_BLACKOUT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_PING_BLACKOUT_01.text: Blackout! Grab it when you want it.

DUT_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.text: Drinks are on me. Well. On me.

DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_01.text: My knees are older than this inn.

DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SQ3_CHATTER_02.text: Back home the worst thing in the dark was a coyote.

PEG_SQ3_SPRINTER_BEHIND_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_SPRINTER_BEHIND_02.text: Check your six, it's a quick one!

PEG_SQ3_BOSS_INCOMING_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_BOSS_INCOMING_01.text: Boss incoming. Spread out, don't bunch up.

PEG_SQ3_CRATE_MOVED_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CRATE_MOVED_01.text: The crate's moved. Of course it has.

PEG_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_PING_DEATHSDOOR_01.text: Death's Door. Do try not to waste it.

PEG_SQ3_PING_FORTIFY_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_PING_FORTIFY_01.text: Fortify! The windows will thank us.

PEG_SQ3_CMD_TRAIN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CMD_TRAIN_01.text: Train them. Yes, I know the drill.

PEG_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SQ3_CMD_BUY_PERKS_01.text: A drink for the road. Several, in fact.

PEG_SQ3_CMD_FETCH_PART_01.speaker: PEG
