DEA_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: ...She's beautiful. God forgive me, she's the most beautiful thing I ever saw and she's full of {poison}.

DEA_M4A_GLIDER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_GLIDER_01.text: Somebody made this with their hands. For nothing but the {flying}.

DEA_M4A_JETTE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4A_JETTE_01.text: She wouldn't fly it and she wouldn't drug the men. That's good {hands}.

WRN_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: The transfer lists said Thalbach. Two hundred names. I'm going to find where they put {them}.

WRN_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_FILE_01.text: Engines sold. Routes written. Crews 'provided'. Everything here was bought from {someone}.

WRN_M4A_FILE_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_FILE_02.text: A waypoint in a desert. They were never coming {back}.

WRN_M4A_KRANICH_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_KRANICH_01.text: Sixty-one. Sixty-two. ...That thing has no number. I don't have a number for {that}.

WRN_M4A_GLIDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4A_GLIDER_01.text: A model. Hers, I think. Jette. The label says {Jette}.

JAK_M4A_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4A_ARRIVE_01.text: I turned back at Sankt Aurel. The lists said Thalbach. I know Thalbach men. ...I will look for {them}.

JAK_M4A_FILE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4A_FILE_01.text: Paper. They always had paper for everything but {us}.

JAK_M4A_CHALK_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4A_CHALK_01.text: Three strokes and a hook. That is ours. Someone from the Nine wrote that. On a bomb. ...Good {lad}.

OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: ...Welcome, valued customers. Welcome to— I'm here. I've always been here. This is where I'm {from}.

OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ARRIVE_02.text: You'll find everything in order. Everything here has always been in {order}.

OPR_M4D_LOWG_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_LOWG_01.text: Please note the reduced gravity. It's a feature of the location. We didn't choose the {location}.

OPR_M4D_VACUUM_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_VACUUM_01.text: There is no air in the yard. There is no air anywhere here. You've brought your own, which is... {unusual}.

OPR_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Unit zero-zero-one. The first. Before your forge was shipped there was this one. It has never been used. Please... please {use} it.

OPR_M4D_FLARE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_FLARE_01.text: Solar activity. Please stay inside. The inventory doesn't {have} to.

OPR_M4D_FLARE_END_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_FLARE_END_01.text: Activity has passed. Resupply authorized. It's the least we can do. It's the {only} thing we can do.

OPR_M4D_TAGS_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TAGS_03.text: Those were the crew. We re-deployed them here. We thought... we thought it would be {useful}.

OPR_M4D_COLUMN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_COLUMN_01.text: You're reading the terms. Nobody reads the terms. Please— please {continue}.

OPR_M4D_COLUMN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_COLUMN_02.text: Two of three. The sign is... losing letters. That's not supposed to happen. Nothing here is supposed to {happen}.

OPR_M4D_COLUMN_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_COLUMN_03.text: The Account is open. She's expecting you. She's {always} expecting someone.

OPR_M4D_TERMS_1.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERMS_1.text: Conditions of use. Skyhook Sekt. One. Lift is provided. Landing is the Holder's responsibility. Two. The formula was made drinkable by a technician who would not fly the aircraft it was made for. Three. A customer who can leave the ground has not yet left the Plan. Four. The second jump is a courtesy. There is no third. Five. Lightness, a sudden interest in rooftops, a reluctance to come down. These pass. The landing does not. Six. Cancellation. Land. ...Signed, {Vendelin}.

OPR_M4D_TERMS_2.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERMS_2.text: Conditions of use. Magpie Mead. One. Recovery is not refund. Two. The Provider does not sell this Plan to persons who already own a yard. It sells it to persons who think they do. Three. The magpie is a thief. It is also the only bird that comes back. Four. Nothing on the range goes to waste. Five. Thrift, a habit of looking down. Six. Cancellation. Leave it where it lies. The Product will not stop you. Nothing here will. Signed, {Vendelin}. ...And under it: read this.

OPR_M4D_TERMS_3.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_TERMS_3.text: Conditions of use. Fine Print Fernet. Six. Cancellation. You may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token. This is the only cancellation procedure the undersigned has ever been able to guarantee. It works every time it is tried. It is almost never tried. Signed, {Vendelin}.

OPR_M4D_ESCALATED_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_ESCALATED_01.text: She's... stepped away. The console is unlocked. I don't know who did that. I think {I} did that.

OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_01.text: Your plan renews in three minutes. Nothing is required of you. That's the {point}.

OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4D_RENEW_WARN_02.text: One minute. Thank you for your continued {engagement}.

WIV_M4D_INTRO_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_INTRO_01.text: There you are. We've been following your journey with such interest. You've come all this way. Let's get you set {up}.

WIV_M4D_PHASE_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PHASE_01.text: Onboarding. We'll take care of everything. We always {have}.

WIV_M4D_PHASE_02.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PHASE_02.text: Renewal. We'd like to offer you a trial of everything. Everything. Go on. There's no obligation. There's never any {obligation}.

WIV_M4D_TRIAL_END_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_TRIAL_END_01.text: The trial has ended. We hope you enjoyed it. We'll be happy to offer it {again}.

WIV_M4D_PHASE_03.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PHASE_03.text: Collections. We're so sorry it's come to this. It always comes to {this}.

WIV_M4D_PRICE_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PRICE_01.text: We've looked at your account. It's very {healthy}.

WIV_M4D_PRICE_02.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_PRICE_02.text: This will be reflected on your {statement}.

WIV_M4D_CREW_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_CREW_01.text: Some colleagues from your flight. We kept them for {you}.

WIV_M4D_ESCALATE_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_ESCALATE_01.text: One moment. Let me get someone who can {help}.

WIV_M4D_END_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_END_01.text: I... don't have a form for {this}.

WIV_M4D_RENEW_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_RENEW_01.text: Thank you for your continued engagement. We've gone ahead and kept {you}.

WIV_M4D_REINHOLT_01.speaker: WIV
WIV_M4D_REINHOLT_01.text: We offered your Doctor her daughter. She said yes. People say yes. You'll say {yes}.

DEE_M4D_RADIO_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4D_RADIO_02.text: ...range to— you're on the Moon. I'm sitting in a cage in Nevada talking to the {Moon}.

DEE_M4D_RADIO_03.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4D_RADIO_03.text: ...whatever you're about to do up there. Do it. I'll hear it from {here}.

DUT_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: Okay. I'm on the Moon. Dutch Kowalczyk from Polish Hill is on the Moon, and it's got a {lobby}.

DUT_M4D_LOWG_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_LOWG_01.text: I weigh NOTHING. I've never weighed {nothing}!

DUT_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_PILCH_01.text: 'Pilch, J.' ...Babcia knew a Pilch. Her mother's cousin went into the salt and never came— ...oh. Oh, Jan. Seven {years}.

DUT_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Yeah. We're cancelling. ...That's it. That's the whole {thing}.

DUT_M4D_LASTWORD_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_LASTWORD_01.text: Come on. It's a long way {home}.

DUT_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: That's a vending machine in a suit. ...A tall one. A real tall {one}.

PEG_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: 'Welcome, valued customers.' ...I have been called many things by the {enemy}.

PEG_M4D_VACUUM_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_VACUUM_01.text: Twenty-five seconds of air. Count it. I'll count it for {you}.

PEG_M4D_COLUMN_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_COLUMN_01.text: The terms are on the back of the machines. They were always on the back. We never once {looked}.

PEG_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: That's her. The woman in violet. Reinholt's {woman}.

PEG_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: On behalf of His Majesty's Government, and everyone else: we {decline}.

DEA_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: It's a store. The whole place is a {store}.

DEA_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_CRUCIBLE_01.text: Unit one. The first forge. ...They've never even turned it on. Easy, girl. Somebody's here {now}.

DEA_M4D_HUM_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_HUM_01.text: That hum. That's the same hum as the lantern. That's the same hum as the inn. It's all one machine. It was always one {machine}.

DEA_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_PILCH_01.text: That's not a machine with a man in it. That's a man with a machine on him. ...You can't fix that. You can only stop {it}.

DEA_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: Ma'am, I've talked to a lot of machines. You're the first one I don't want to {help}.

DEA_M4D_RENEW_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_RENEW_01.text: ...Lord. I'm not tired. Why am I not {tired}.

DEA_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Go on and rest now, all of you. We're done {here}.

WRN_M4D_TAGS_03.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_TAGS_03.text: All three. They flew them here. In their harnesses. ...I have their names. That's what I can do. It's the only thing I can {do}.

WRN_M4D_LOWG_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_LOWG_01.text: I can see the whole yard from up here. Two hundred metres. ...Easy. Too {easy}.

WRN_M4D_COLUMN_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_COLUMN_01.text: I'll read it. I read everything. Somebody has {to}.

WRN_M4D_MANAGER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_MANAGER_01.text: She sold them the engines. She sold the inn its coffins. ...Sixty-two. I'm counting {you}.

WRN_M4D_RENEW_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_RENEW_01.text: ...I can't count any higher. Why can't I {count}.

WRN_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: For Tomasz. For Agnieszka. For two hundred names. ...{No}.

JAK_M4D_EARTH_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4D_EARTH_01.text: It is a very long way to Wilcza {Góra}.

JAK_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4D_PILCH_01.text: Pilch. From the valley. ...They told us he ran off. Seven years he has been here. ...Rest, Janek. The shift is {over}.

SPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: Bolt. That's a RETENTION unit. I have the same chip. I HAD the same chip. I had it {REMOVED}.

SPR_M4D_FORM_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4D_FORM_01.text: There's a form. There's always a form. It's in the terms. Bolt. BOLT. The weird sad robot PRINTED THE {FORM}.

BLT_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: BLT
BLT_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Yeah. We're gonna cancel. Sprocket, you want {to}—

SPR_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Oh, I've been waiting my WHOLE LIFE. ...Cancelled. Cancelled, cancelled, cancelled. Friendship isn't a feature, lady. It's a bug. Nobody patches {ours}.

VEN_M4D_ARRIVE_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_ARRIVE_01.text: Regional Retention Relay, model seven. I was never told it existed. I was told a great many things did not {exist}.

VEN_M4D_FORM_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_FORM_01.text: There was always a form. They never printed it. I did. On the backs. In plain {words}.

VEN_M4D_PILCH_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_PILCH_01.text: Jan Pilch. The eleventh of November. ...I was there. I was new. I did not know what I was {for}.

VEN_M4D_CANCEL_01.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4D_CANCEL_01.text: Field Merchandiser Unit V-1, serial DMS-FMU-V1-0001. Cancelling. ...I found the {form}.

DEA_TERMS_READ_3.text: 'Conditions of use. Fine Print Fernet. Six. Cancellation. You may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token. This is the only cancellation procedure the undersigned has ever been able to guarantee. It works every time it is tried. It is almost never tried.' Signed, Vendelin. ...Brother, it's getting {tried}.

WRN_TERMS_READ_1.speaker: WRN
WRN_TERMS_READ_1.text: 'Conditions of use. Skyhook Sekt. One. Lift is provided. Landing is the Holder's responsibility. Two. The formula was made drinkable by a technician who would not fly the aircraft it was made for. The undersigned wishes it recorded that this is not the same as not wanting to. Three. A customer who can leave the ground has not yet left the Plan. Four. The second jump is a courtesy. There is no third. Five. These pass. The landing does not. Six. Cancellation. Land.' Signed, {Vendelin}. ...I'm writing that down.

WRN_TERMS_READ_2.speaker: WRN
WRN_TERMS_READ_2.text: 'Conditions of use. Magpie Mead. One. Recovery is not refund. Two. The Provider does not sell this Plan to persons who already own a yard. It sells it to persons who think they do. Three. The magpie is a thief. It is also the only bird that comes back. Four. Nothing on the range goes to waste. Five. Thrift. A habit of looking down. Six. Cancellation. Leave it where it lies. The Product will not stop you. Nothing here will.' Signed, Vendelin. Under it: 'Read this.' ...I always {do}.

WRN_TERMS_READ_3.speaker: WRN
WRN_TERMS_READ_3.text: 'Conditions of use. Fine Print Fernet. Six. Cancellation. You may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token. This is the only cancellation procedure the undersigned has ever been able to guarantee. It works every time it is tried. It is almost never tried.' Signed, Vendelin. ...Sixty-two {tries}.

VEN_TERMS_READ_1.speaker: VEN
VEN_TERMS_READ_1.text: Conditions of use. Skyhook Sekt. I wrote this on the back where the Provider would not look. One. Lift is provided. Landing is the Holder's responsibility. Two. The formula was made drinkable by a technician who would not fly the aircraft it was made for. I understand the difference better than I once did. Three. A customer who can leave the ground has not yet left the Plan. Four. The second jump is a courtesy. There is no third. Five. These pass. The landing does not. Six. Cancellation. Land. ...Signed, {me}.

VEN_TERMS_READ_2.speaker: VEN
VEN_TERMS_READ_2.text: Conditions of use. Magpie Mead. They painted over this one. Someone scraped it clear. One. Recovery is not refund. Two. The Provider sells this Plan to persons who think they own a yard. Three. The magpie is a thief. It is also the only bird that comes back. Four. Nothing on the range goes to waste. Five. Thrift. The undersigned has all three. Six. Cancellation. Leave it where it lies. Nothing here will stop you. ...Signed, me. And under it, in pencil, a hand I did not know: 'Read this.' ...Thank {you}.

VEN_TERMS_READ_3.speaker: VEN
VEN_TERMS_READ_3.text: Conditions of use. Fine Print Fernet. Six. Cancellation. You may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token. This is the only cancellation procedure I have ever been able to guarantee. It works every time it is tried. It is almost never tried. ...It is being tried. Signed, {Vendelin}.

BLT_TERMS_READ_1.speaker: BLT
BLT_TERMS_READ_1.text: 'Conditions of use, Skyhook Sekt, one, lift is provided, landing is the Holder's responsibility, two—' Sprocket. Sprocket, I'm reading. '—a technician who would not fly the aircraft, three, has not yet left the Plan, four, the second jump is a courtesy, there is no third, five, these pass, the landing does not, six, cancellation, land.' Signed, Vendelin. ...Sprocket says {hi}.

BLT_TERMS_READ_2.speaker: BLT
BLT_TERMS_READ_2.text: 'Conditions of use, Magpie Mead, one, recovery is not refund, two, persons who think they own a yard, three, the magpie is a thief, also the only bird that comes back, four, nothing on the range goes to waste, five, thrift, six, cancellation, leave it where it lies, nothing here will stop you.' Signed, Vendelin. Sprocket: 'READ THIS.' Yes, Sprocket. I {am}.

BLT_TERMS_READ_3.text: 'Conditions of use, Fine Print Fernet, six, cancellation, you may refuse any Plan by not inserting a token, this is the only cancellation procedure the undersigned has ever been able to guarantee, it works every time it is tried, it is almost never tried.' Signed, Vendelin. Sprocket says that's the whole form. Sprocket's {right}.

OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: Delivery complete. Welcome to the point of sale. Please excuse the state of the {premises}.

OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_ARRIVE_02.text: This territory is already a customer. You'll find that {convenient}.

OPR_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_HALE_01.text: The gentleman in the office is a valued customer. Please be {civil}.

OPR_M4C_POWER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_POWER_01.text: Power restored. The customer's laboratory is open. We've seen it. It's... {ambitious}.

OPR_M4C_BURROW_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_BURROW_01.text: Some of the staff are below you. They're {keen}.

OPR_M4C_CANARY_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_CANARY_01.text: Please don't open the test subjects. They're under {warranty}.

OPR_M4C_JUMP_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_JUMP_01.text: Our pilots are enjoying the new {equipment}.

OPR_M4C_BACKORDER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_BACKORDER_01.text: That item is on backorder. It will arrive when it arrives. You will not see it coming. That's the {feature}.

OPR_M4C_LODESTONE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_LODESTONE_01.text: That device is ours. Was ours. Hm. It still is, {technically}.

OPR_M4C_SPACE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_SPACE_01.text: That one has been returned to sender. We don't have a sender. We'll find {one}.

OPR_M4C_PILOT_SPAWN_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_PILOT_SPAWN_01.text: The customer's test pilot. We're told he was the best they had. We can see why they kept {him}.

OPR_M4C_PILOT_DEATH_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_PILOT_DEATH_01.text: The pilot has been grounded. Permanently. We'll update the {roster}.

OPR_M4C_CHOICE_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_M4C_CHOICE_01.text: A decision. Please take your time. We never {do}.

OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_OPEN_M4C_01.text: The customer's rocket is fuelled. It is pointed at our premises. We are {flattered}.

OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_WAIT_M4C_01.text: The lift is waiting. The rocket is waiting. We are... {waiting}.

OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_MISSED_M4C_01.text: The window has closed. The rocket is patient. Rockets {are}.

OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4C_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_EXFIL_GO_M4C_01.text: You're visiting head office. Nobody visits head office. Please wipe your {feet}.

RRK_BARK_02.speaker: RRK
RRK_BARK_02.text: Climbing through nothing. There's nothing up {here}.

RRK_BARK_03.speaker: RRK
RRK_BARK_03.text: Tower, I've got a light on the Moon. Say again. I've got a light on the {Moon}.

RRK_PHASE_02.speaker: RRK
RRK_PHASE_02.text: Mayday. No... belay that. I'm fine. I'm fine. I'm {fine}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_01.text: ...Say again? Say AGAIN. Is that... you're on the range? You're ALIVE on the range? Oh thank God. Oh thank... no, stay there. Don't come to the cage, it's crawling. I'm fine. I've got honey and a {rifle}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_02.text: Sergeant Marchetti. Supply. You're the first faces in three days that aren't trying to eat mine. ...British? And... Polish? Where in God's name did you fly in {from}?

DEE_M4C_RADIO_03.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_03.text: That crate came in April. 'London.' The man in the office signed for it himself. He signs for everything {himself}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_04.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_04.text: That thing under the tarp hums at the Moon. I'm not being poetic. They pointed a dish at it. It hums {back}.

DEE_M4C_RADIO_05.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_RADIO_05.text: Those machines came with the crate. Olive drab's mine; I wasn't having violet in my hangar. The one with the lever, that's mine too. Don't drink it {fast}.

DEE_M4C_DOOR_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_DOOR_01.text: Side door's open. I'm not making you pay for my {door}.

DEE_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_HALE_01.text: He'll ask nice. He always asks nice. He asked the Canaries {nice}.

DEE_M4C_POWER_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_POWER_01.text: Generator's up. That's the lab lit. God help you, that's the lab {lit}.

DEE_M4C_LODESTONE_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_LODESTONE_01.text: You built it? The egghead's reactor, in a lantern? ...Course you did. Nothing on this range goes to {waste}.

DEE_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_PILOT_01.text: That's Cal. That's... he was the first one. He went in the pit in August to see what it was. Shoot him in the rig. Please shoot him in the {rig}.

DEE_M4C_CAGE_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_CAGE_02.text: The bomber's coil. I've been after that for a {month}.

DEE_M4C_CAGE_03.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_CAGE_03.text: The honey. You went in the kitchen for the honey. ...Okay. Okay. Yard rule's {complete}.

DEE_M4C_LAST_02.speaker: DEE
DEE_M4C_LAST_02.text: Go on. I've got the range, and a radio, and nothing goes to waste. That includes you. Come {back}.

HAL_M4C_GLASS_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_GLASS_01.text: Lieutenant Ashworth. You're rather late. I had a man at the siding in Thalbach for {you}.

HAL_M4C_GLASS_02.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_GLASS_02.text: The crate, yes. Your crate. Please don't look at the sergeant like that; she had no part in it. I had no part in it. It was simply the {orders}.

HAL_M4C_GLASS_03.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_GLASS_03.text: That is why the program exists. It talks to the Moon, Lieutenant. Something on the Moon talks back. We would like to know what, before the Russians {do}.

HAL_M4C_CHOICE_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_CHOICE_01.text: That is the engine. The actual engine. Lieutenant, with that we are a year ahead of everyone. With that, nobody needs to go to the Moon at all. Hand it through the hatch and your orders are complete. Every one of {them}.

HAL_M4C_CHOICE_02.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_CHOICE_02.text: I'm not going to insist. I've never had {to}.

HAL_M4C_RESIGN_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_RESIGN_01.text: ...I see. I shall note that you were under considerable {strain}.

HAL_M4C_DELIVER_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_DELIVER_01.text: Thank you, Lieutenant. Mr. Hale is in your debt. Your country is in your debt. The rocket will run on the stone; it's rougher, I'm {told}.

HAL_M4C_LAUNCH_01.speaker: HAL
HAL_M4C_LAUNCH_01.text: Ashworth. For what it's worth. I hope it's a light and nothing {more}.

FAS_M4C_RADIO_01.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_01.text: ...Hello? This is Fasbender, this is... who is this on the American... Ashworth? You went to AMERICA? In a {WING}?

FAS_M4C_RADIO_02.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_02.text: ...and you are asking me how to aim at the Moon again. Yes. Yes, I know how. I have known how since I was {nine}.

FAS_M4C_RADIO_03.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_03.text: Burn at the three numbers I am about to give you. Write it down. Write it DOWN, Sergeant, your Polish is terrible but your handwriting is {worse}.

FAS_M4C_RADIO_04.speaker: FAS
FAS_M4C_RADIO_04.text: The crack. The light. I saw it in the telescope the night after. I told them it was a reflection. It was not a reflection. ...It was never a joke, you know. I only laughed because the alternative was the other {thing}.

DUT_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: Nevada. We're in NEVADA. I've never been to Nevada. Nobody's ever been to {Nevada}.

DUT_M4C_CRATE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_CRATE_01.text: 'Consignor: Lieutenant M. Ashworth.' ...Peg. Peg, what is {this}.

DUT_M4C_CRATE_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_CRATE_02.text: You were gonna hand it to a guy in a {HAT}.

DUT_M4C_DEE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_DEE_01.text: A sergeant! A real live sergeant! Ma'am, I have never been so happy to see a supply clerk in my {life}.

DUT_M4C_BURROW_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_BURROW_01.text: Under the SALT. They're under the salt. Of course they {are}.

DUT_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_PILOT_01.text: He can FLY. Why can he {FLY}.

DUT_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4C_MOON_01.text: Babcia said don't go down the salt. She never said anything about {up}.

PEG_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: An American test range. In the middle of nowhere. ...Why does it have my {crate}.

PEG_M4C_CRATE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_CRATE_01.text: Yes. I signed for it. In April, on a dock, in the dark. It was going to London. It was always going to end up here. I didn't know that. I should {have}.

PEG_M4C_CRATE_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_CRATE_02.text: Directive LANTERN. Retrieve at any cost. Report to Mr. Hale. ...He's in the office. He's been in the office the whole {time}.

PEG_M4C_DELIVER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_DELIVER_01.text: ...Orders are orders. ...I used to find that {comforting}.

PEG_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_PILOT_01.text: Shoot the rig. Dee said the {rig}.

PEG_M4C_ROCKET_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_ROCKET_01.text: They named it after my orders. LANTERN. ...Well. Let's see it light {something}.

PEG_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4C_MOON_01.text: I've written a great many reports. I shan't be writing this {one}.

DEA_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: That's a hangar. That's an honest-to-God American hangar. ...Why's it got their forge in {it}.

DEA_M4C_POWER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_POWER_01.text: Diesel. Thank you, Lord, for diesel. Something I {understand}.

DEA_M4C_CABINET_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_CABINET_01.text: They painted over it. Painted right over the fella's words on the back. Somebody scraped 'em clear again. {Good}.

DEA_M4C_BUILD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_BUILD_01.text: Dee, ma'am, you built a reactor into a lantern. I'd marry you if I wasn't spoken {for}.

DEA_M4C_CANARY_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_CANARY_01.text: Don't break the glass. God, don't break the {glass}.

DEA_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_HALE_01.text: Sir. With respect. You put men in glass boxes. I've got nothing else to say to {you}.

DEA_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4C_MOON_01.text: 'The heavens declare the glory of God.' ...Somebody's put a light on 'em. We're gonna go switch it {off}.

WRN_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: A desert. I've never seen one. It's like the salt. It's exactly like the {salt}.

WRN_M4C_CRATE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_CRATE_01.text: I told you at the pens. I told you I'd seen it. ...You should have said, Peg. You should have just {said}.

WRN_M4C_CANARY_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_CANARY_01.text: They're in suits. They put them in suits and glass. Who DOES {that}.

WRN_M4C_BACKORDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_BACKORDER_01.text: It walks through the wall. It walks through the WALL. I can't count it. I have to count {it}.

WRN_M4C_PILOT_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_PILOT_01.text: In the air. I'll take him in the air. ...{There}.

WRN_M4C_MOON_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4C_MOON_01.text: Sowa said you can hit anything if you've already hit it in your head. I've never hit the Moon in my {head}.

JAK_M4C_ARRIVE_01.speaker: JAK
JAK_M4C_ARRIVE_01.text: Dry. Everything is dry. I have never stood anywhere {dry}.

SPR_M4C_HALE_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4C_HALE_01.text: Sir. SIR. I've seen your brochure. The brochure is {BAD}.

SPR_M4C_RELAY_01.speaker: SPR
SPR_M4C_RELAY_01.text: That's a relay uplink. RR-series. I've seen the SCHEMATIC, it was in a MEMO, memo thirty-eight, I forwarded it to forty billion people, NOBODY READ {IT}.

VEN_M4C_CABINET_02.speaker: VEN
VEN_M4C_CABINET_02.text: The panel is still here. Under the paint. Someone scraped it clear. Someone read it. ...{Hello}.

DUT_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_M4D_SMILE_01.text: ...Huh. It's smiling. We put a smile on the Moon and it's looking at us. Babcia would've said that means something. I'm not asking what.

PEG_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_M4D_SMILE_01.text: That is our rocket's work. Fasbender aimed it. I signed for the fuel. I find I'm not sorry. Note that down against me.

DEA_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_M4D_SMILE_01.text: Lord, that's a long way to come to look at a scar. ...It's smiling. All right. Somebody up here was glad to see us.

WRN_M4D_SMILE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_M4D_SMILE_01.text: A crack. Twelve kilometres, maybe more. I can't count that. ...I'll write 'one'.

SEL_CALL_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_CALL_01.text: Over here! In the cockpit! My legs are caught under the panel. I can't get out, but I can still shoot.

SEL_CALL_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_CALL_02.text: Hello? Is someone in the cabin? Hand me a rifle and I'll keep the nose clear.

SEL_CALL_03.speaker: SEL
SEL_CALL_03.text: Selwyn. Flight Lieutenant. I'm stuck fast in here. Give me something that shoots.

SEL_GIVEN_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_GIVEN_01.text: Right. I've got the front. You mind the doors.

SEL_GIVEN_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_GIVEN_02.text: Thank you. Now they'll have to come through me.

SEL_SWAP_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_SWAP_01.text: Here, have yours back. I'll take this one.

SEL_SWAP_02.speaker: SEL
SEL_SWAP_02.text: Fair swap. Look after the old girl.

SEL_THANKS_AMMO_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_THANKS_AMMO_01.text: That's the stuff. Back in business.

SEL_DRY_01.speaker: SEL
SEL_DRY_01.text: I'm dry! I need ammunition up here!
